classes/adept-917.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/adept-917.description: Proficient with all simple weapons. Adepts gain no armor or shield proficiency from the class.

classes/adept-917.name: Spells
classes/adept-917.description: Prepare divine spells from the adept list. Wisdom determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Adepts prepare spells through daily prayer or meditation and do not spontaneously convert prepared spells to cure or inflict spells.

classes/adept-917.name: Summon Familiar
classes/adept-917.description: At 2nd level, gain a familiar using the same familiar rules used by sorcerers and wizards.

classes/archivist-74.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/archivist-74.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and with light and medium armor, but not shields.

classes/archivist-74.name: Spellcasting
classes/archivist-74.description: Casts divine spells from a prayerbook. Intelligence determines the highest spell level the archivist can learn, prepare, or cast and sets spell save DCs; Wisdom provides bonus spells per day. Spells are prepared after rest and study.

classes/archivist-74.name: Prayerbook
classes/archivist-74.description: Keeps divine spells in a prayerbook and can prepare only spells recorded there, except read magic. Begins with all 0-level cleric spells plus selected 1st-level cleric spells, gains two cleric spells for the prayerbook at each archivist level, and can copy additional divine spells from scrolls under the normal spellbook-copying rules.

classes/archivist-74.name: Dark Knowledge
classes/archivist-74.description: 3/day at 1st level, with one additional daily use every three archivist levels. Make the Knowledge check appropriate to the creature type (DC 15); the effect lasts 1 minute unless stated otherwise and normally affects a creature or creatures of the same race within 60 feet. Tactics (1st) grants allies +1 to attack rolls against the affected creatures, improving to +2/+3 when the check beats the DC by 10/20. Puissance (5th) similarly grants +1/+2/+3 on saves against the affected creatures' abilities. Foe (8th) grants +1d6/+2d6/+3d6 weapon damage. Dread Secret (11th) dazzles, dazes, or stuns one target for 1 round depending on the check margin. Foreknowledge (14th) grants allies within 30 feet +1/+2/+3 insight AC against attacks from the affected creature.

classes/archivist-74.name: Scribe Scroll
classes/archivist-74.description: Gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

classes/archivist-74.name: Lore Mastery
classes/archivist-74.description: Gain +2 on Decipher Script checks and on one chosen Knowledge skill. Choose another Knowledge skill for this +2 bonus at 7th, 13th, and 17th level; each choice is permanent.

classes/archivist-74.name: Still Mind
classes/archivist-74.description: Gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

classes/archivist-74.name: Bonus Feat
classes/archivist-74.description: At 10th level and again at 20th level, choose a bonus feat from Skill Focus (any Knowledge skill), Spell Focus, any metamagic feat, or any item creation feat.

classes/aristocrat-31.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/aristocrat-31.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/barbarian-89.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Fast Movement (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: Your land speed increases by 10 feet while you wear no armor, light armor, or medium armor and are not carrying a heavy load. Apply this bonus before reductions from armor or encumbrance.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Illiteracy
classes/barbarian-89.description: You do not automatically know how to read and write. Spending 2 skill points grants literacy in every language you can speak. Taking a level in any other class grants literacy automatically; entering barbarian after another class does not remove existing literacy.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Rage (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: Rage begins at 1 use per day and gains another daily use every four barbarian levels, to 6/day at 20th. While raging you gain +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, and +2 morale on Will saves, but take -2 AC; the rage lasts 3 + your improved Constitution modifier rounds, restricts many skills, spellcasting, and item activations, and normally leaves you fatigued for the encounter. You can rage only once per encounter and can start it only during your own action.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or when attacked by an invisible opponent, unless you are immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, you gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Trap Sense (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: Gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps and +1 dodge AC against trap attacks. Both bonuses increase by +1 every three barbarian levels thereafter through +6 at 18th level, and trap-sense bonuses from multiple classes stack.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: You can no longer be flanked, except by a rogue whose rogue level is at least four higher than your effective level for this ability. Levels from classes that grant uncanny dodge stack for this purpose.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Damage Reduction (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: Gain damage reduction 1/- against weapon and natural-attack damage at 7th level. It improves by 1 at 10th, 13th, 16th, and 19th level, reaching 5/-. Damage reduction can reduce an instance of damage to 0 but not below 0.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Greater Rage (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: While raging, your Strength and Constitution bonuses improve to +6 each and your morale bonus on Will saves improves to +3; the -2 AC penalty remains.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Indomitable Will (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: While raging, gain +4 on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects. This stacks with the rage morale bonus and other applicable modifiers.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Tireless Rage (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: You no longer become fatigued when a rage ends.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Mighty Rage (Ex)
classes/barbarian-89.description: While raging, your Strength and Constitution bonuses improve to +8 each and your morale bonus on Will saves improves to +4; the -2 AC penalty remains. A barbarian who becomes lawful loses the ability to rage and cannot gain additional barbarian levels.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/beguiler-100.description: Proficient with all simple weapons plus the hand crossbow, rapier, shortbow, and short sword, and with light armor but not shields.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Spells
classes/beguiler-100.description: Cast arcane spells spontaneously from the beguiler list using Intelligence. When you gain access to a new spell level, you automatically know every beguiler-list spell of that level. Intelligence determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day; Advanced Learning can permanently add additional eligible spells.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Armored Mage
classes/beguiler-100.description: Ignore arcane spell failure for beguiler spells while wearing light armor. This benefit does not extend to other armor or to arcane spells gained from other classes.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Trapfinding
classes/beguiler-100.description: Use Search to locate traps with DC above 20 and Disable Device to disarm magic traps. If you beat a trap's Disable Device DC by 10 or more, you can study and bypass it without disarming it.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Cloaked Casting
classes/beguiler-100.description: Against a foe denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, beguiler spells gain +1 to save DC at 2nd level. At 8th level gain +2 on caster-level checks to overcome that foe's spell resistance; at 14th the save-DC bonus becomes +2; at 20th you automatically overcome that foe's spell resistance.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Surprise Casting
classes/beguiler-100.description: After a successful combat feint, the target is denied its Dexterity bonus against your next melee attack or spell made on or before your next turn while you remain in melee. At 6th level, feinting becomes a move action; with Improved Feint, it becomes a swift action instead.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Advanced Learning
classes/beguiler-100.description: At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level, add one sorcerer/wizard enchantment or illusion spell to your beguiler spell list. The chosen spell cannot exceed the highest spell level you already know and permanently joins your list once selected.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Silent Spell
classes/beguiler-100.description: Gain Silent Spell as a bonus feat at 5th level.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Still Spell
classes/beguiler-100.description: Gain Still Spell as a bonus feat at 10th level.

classes/cleric-91.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/cleric-91.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and shields except tower shields. A cleric with the War domain can also gain the deity's favored-weapon proficiency and Weapon Focus benefits when the domain rules call for them.

classes/cleric-91.name: Aura (Ex)
classes/cleric-91.description: If your deity or chosen alignment domain is chaotic, evil, good, or lawful, you project the corresponding alignment aura with strength based on your cleric level.

classes/cleric-91.name: Spells
classes/cleric-91.description: Cast divine spells from the cleric list. Wisdom determines the highest spell level you can prepare or cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Cleric spells are prepared in advance, and domain slots are tracked separately from ordinary cleric slots.

classes/cleric-91.name: Deity, Domains, and Domain Spells
classes/cleric-91.description: Choose a deity or a deityless spiritual focus and select two permitted domains. Each domain grants a power and a domain spell at each spell level; domain spell slots can be prepared only from one of your chosen domains. Alignment domains must match your alignment.

classes/cleric-91.name: Spontaneous Casting
classes/cleric-91.description: A good cleric, or a neutral cleric of a good deity, can sacrifice a prepared non-domain spell to cast an eligible cure spell of the same level or lower. Evil clerics use inflict spells instead. A neutral cleric of a neutral deity chooses cure or inflict and keeps that choice.

classes/cleric-91.name: Chaotic, Evil, Good, and Lawful Spells
classes/cleric-91.description: You cannot cast a spell with an alignment descriptor opposed to your own alignment or your deity's alignment.

classes/cleric-91.name: Turn or Rebuke Undead (Su)
classes/cleric-91.description: Channel divine power through a holy or unholy symbol to affect undead. Good clerics turn or destroy undead; evil clerics rebuke or command them. Neutral clerics follow the choice required by their deity/alignment rules. You can attempt this 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day.

classes/cleric-91.name: Bonus Languages
classes/cleric-91.description: Celestial, Abyssal, and Infernal are available as cleric bonus-language choices in addition to languages available from race and other rules.

classes/cloistered-cleric-120.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/cloistered-cleric-120.description: Proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

classes/cloistered-cleric-120.name: Lore (Ex)
classes/cloistered-cleric-120.description: Use the bardic knowledge class feature with your cloistered-cleric level in place of bard level.

classes/cloistered-cleric-120.name: Deity, Domains, and Domain Spells
classes/cloistered-cleric-120.description: In addition to two normal cleric domains, automatically gain the Knowledge domain. You receive its granted power and may prepare the bonus domain spell from Knowledge or either of your two regular domains.

classes/cloistered-cleric-120.name: Spellcasting
classes/cloistered-cleric-120.description: Use cleric spellcasting with the cloistered-cleric class adjustments, including the additional source-listed spells added to the class spell list at levels 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, and 9.

classes/commoner-32.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/commoner-32.description: Proficient with one chosen simple weapon. You gain no proficiency with other weapons, armor, or shields from the Commoner class; the weapon choice is handled by the class training selection.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Proficient with simple weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Bonus Languages
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Draconic is available as a dragon-shaman bonus language in addition to languages otherwise available from your race and other rules.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Draconic Aura
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Project one known draconic aura at a time as a swift action; dismiss or replace it with a free action. At 1st level choose three of Energy Shield, Power, Presence, Resistance, Senses, Toughness, and Vigor; learn one additional aura at 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th until all seven are known. Aura bonus starts at +1 and improves to +2 at 5th, +3 at 10th, +4 at 15th, and +5 at 20th.

Energy Shield.description: While this aura is active, a creature that strikes you or an affected ally with a natural attack or nonreach melee weapon takes 2 points of your totem dragon's breath-weapon energy damage for each point of your current draconic aura bonus.

Power.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies gain a bonus on melee damage rolls equal to your current draconic aura bonus.

Presence.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies gain a bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks equal to your current draconic aura bonus.

Resistance.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies gain resistance to your totem dragon's breath-weapon energy type equal to 5 × your current draconic aura bonus.

Senses.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies gain a bonus on Listen checks, Spot checks, and initiative checks equal to your current draconic aura bonus.

Toughness.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies gain damage reduction /magic equal to your current draconic aura bonus (maximum DR 5/magic at 20th level).

Vigor.description: While this aura is active, you and affected allies at or below one-half normal hit points gain fast healing equal to your current draconic aura bonus.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Totem Dragon
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Choose one true-dragon totem: black, blue, brass, bronze, copper, gold, green, red, silver, or white. Your alignment must be within one step of the source-listed alignments for that dragon. The choice determines three additional class skills, your breath weapon's energy type and shape, your adaptation, and later energy immunity.

Black.description: Totem class skills: Hide, Move Silently, Swim. Breath weapon: line of acid. At 3rd level gain Water Breathing; at 9th level gain immunity to acid.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Water Breathing
effects.description: You can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use spells and other abilities underwater. This extraordinary adaptation is always active. At 13th level, the class's adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Line of acid
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a line and deals acid damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Acid
effects.description: You are immune to acid damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Blue.description: Totem class skills: Bluff, Hide, Spellcraft. Breath weapon: line of electricity. At 3rd level gain Ventriloquism; at 9th level gain immunity to electricity.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Ventriloquism
effects.description: You can use ventriloquism as a spell-like ability at will. Caster level equals your dragon-shaman level; the save DC uses Charisma. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Line of electricity
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a line and deals electricity damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Electricity
effects.description: You are immune to electricity damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Brass.description: Totem class skills: Bluff, Gather Information, Survival. Breath weapon: line of fire. At 3rd level gain Endure Elements; at 9th level gain immunity to fire.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Endure Elements
effects.description: You can use endure elements on yourself as a spell-like ability at will. Caster level equals your dragon-shaman level. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Line of fire
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a line and deals fire damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Fire
effects.description: You are immune to fire damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Bronze.description: Totem class skills: Disguise, Survival, Swim. Breath weapon: line of electricity. At 3rd level gain Water Breathing; at 9th level gain immunity to electricity.

effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a line and deals electricity damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Electricity
effects.description: You are immune to electricity damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Copper.description: Totem class skills: Bluff, Hide, Jump. Breath weapon: line of acid. At 3rd level gain Spider Climb; at 9th level gain immunity to acid.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Spider Climb
effects.description: You can use spider climb on yourself as a spell-like ability at will. Caster level equals your dragon-shaman level. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Line of acid
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a line and deals acid damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Acid
effects.description: You are immune to acid damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Gold.description: Totem class skills: Disguise, Heal, Swim. Breath weapon: cone of fire. At 3rd level gain Water Breathing; at 9th level gain immunity to fire.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Water Breathing
effects.description: You can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use spells and other abilities underwater. This extraordinary adaptation is always active. At 13th level, the class's adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Cone of fire
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a cone and deals fire damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Fire
effects.description: You are immune to fire damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Green.description: Totem class skills: Bluff, Hide, Move Silently. Breath weapon: cone of acid. At 3rd level gain Water Breathing; at 9th level gain immunity to acid.

effects.description: You can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use spells and other abilities underwater. This extraordinary adaptation is always active. At 13th level, the class's adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Cone of acid
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a cone and deals acid damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Acid
effects.description: You are immune to acid damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Red.description: Totem class skills: Appraise, Bluff, Jump. Breath weapon: cone of fire. At 3rd level gain Treasure Seeker; at 9th level gain immunity to fire.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Treasure Seeker
effects.description: You gain a +5 competence bonus on Appraise and Search checks. This extraordinary adaptation is always active. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Cone of fire
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a cone and deals fire damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Fire
effects.description: You are immune to fire damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

Silver.description: Totem class skills: Bluff, Disguise, Jump. Breath weapon: cone of cold. At 3rd level gain Feather Fall; at 9th level gain immunity to cold.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Feather Fall
effects.description: You can use feather fall on yourself as a spell-like ability at will. Caster level equals your dragon-shaman level. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Cone of cold
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a cone and deals cold damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Cold
effects.description: You are immune to cold damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

White.description: Totem class skills: Hide, Move Silently, Swim. Breath weapon: cone of cold. At 3rd level gain Icewalker; at 9th level gain immunity to cold.

effects.name: Draconic Adaptation · Icewalker
effects.description: You can walk across icy surfaces without reducing your speed or making Balance checks. This extraordinary adaptation is always active. At 13th level, the adaptation-sharing rule can extend it to allies.

effects.name: Totem Breath · Cone of cold
effects.description: Your dragon-shaman breath weapon uses a cone and deals cold damage; its damage, save DC, recharge, and range scale using the Dragon Shaman Breath Weapon feature.

effects.name: Energy Immunity · Cold
effects.description: You are immune to cold damage, the energy type of your chosen totem dragon's breath weapon.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Skill Focus
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: At 2nd, 8th, and 16th level, gain Skill Focus tied to one of the three class skills granted by your chosen totem dragon. Each selection should use a different totem-granted skill; if all three are already covered, the source permits another dragon-shaman class skill.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Draconic Adaptation
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Gain the adaptation associated with your totem dragon. Depending on the totem, this is an always-active extraordinary benefit or an at-will spell-like ability. At 13th level you can share the adaptation with allies within 30 feet as described by the source.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Breath Weapon
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Gain the breath weapon associated with your totem dragon. It deals 2d6 damage at 4th level and +1d6 every two dragon-shaman levels thereafter, with a Reflex save for half at DC 10 + half class level + Constitution modifier. After breathing, wait 1d4 rounds before using it again. Cone/line range increases at 12th and 20th level.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Draconic Resolve
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Gain immunity to paralysis and sleep effects and immunity to the frightful presence of dragons.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Touch of Vitality

resource.recoveryText: The Touch of Vitality pool refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: As a standard action, heal living creatures from a daily pool equal to 2 × dragon-shaman level × Charisma modifier, divided among uses as desired. Beginning at 11th level, spend pool points to remove source-listed conditions or ability damage as well as healing hit points.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Natural Armor
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Gain +1 natural armor at 7th level; the improvement becomes +2 at 12th and +3 at 17th level.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Energy Immunity
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Gain immunity to the energy type of the breath weapon granted by your chosen totem dragon.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Commune with Dragon Spirit

resource.recoveryText: After using Commune with Dragon Spirit, it cannot be used again for seven days.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Contact your dragon totem as commune without the normal material component, focus, or XP cost, asking one question per three dragon-shaman levels. After use, this ability cannot be used again for seven days.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Draconic Wings
classes/dragon-shaman-101.description: Grow wings resembling your totem dragon's, granting a 60-foot fly speed with good maneuverability; while carrying a medium load the fly speed is 40 feet. If you already have wings, you may choose whether the new wings replace them.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Proficient with simple weapons, but not armor or shields. Because draconic invocations have somatic components, armor and shields can impose arcane spell failure on invocation use.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Invocations
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Use known draconic invocations at will as spell-like abilities, normally as standard actions that provoke attacks of opportunity and can be used defensively with Concentration. Charisma sets invocation save DCs. Invocation grades progress from least at 1st level to lesser at 6th, greater at 11th, and dark at 16th; the class table increases invocations known to 8 by 18th level, and each time a new invocation is learned one known invocation may be replaced by another of the same or lower grade.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Breath Weapon
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Use a supernatural breath weapon at will as a standard action, choosing a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line. It begins at 1d6 fire damage with a Reflex save for half at DC 10 + half class level + Constitution modifier, scales to 9d6 at 20th level, and doubles cone/line range at 10th level. You are immune to your own breath weapon.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Dragontouched
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Gain Dragontouched as a bonus feat at 1st level.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Breath Effect
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Learn one breath effect at 2nd, 5th, 10th, 12th, 15th, and 20th level, selecting only effects whose minimum-level prerequisite you meet. A breath use can normally apply one known effect, and the same breath effect cannot be applied in two consecutive rounds unless its rules say otherwise.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Scales
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Gain natural armor +2 at 2nd level, improving to +3 at 8th, +4 at 13th, and +5 at 18th. If you already have a natural armor bonus, use the higher value rather than stacking them.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Dragonkin
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Gain +4 competence on Diplomacy checks to influence dragons and dragonblood creatures, and count as a dragon when determining whether a dragon's frightful presence can affect you.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Damage Reduction
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Gain damage reduction 2/magic at 6th level; it improves to 5/magic at 16th level.

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Immunities
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.description: Gain immunity to paralysis and sleep at 19th level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, one martial weapon chosen when you first enter the class, and light armor. You are not proficient with shields. Dread-necromancer spells can be cast in light armor without arcane spell failure, while medium/heavy armor or shields can impose normal arcane spell failure.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Spellcasting
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Cast arcane spells spontaneously from the dread-necromancer list. When a new spell level is unlocked, you automatically know the class-list spells of that level. Charisma determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day; Advanced Learning can add additional eligible necromancy spells.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Charnel Touch
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: At will, but no more than once per round, make a melee touch attack that deals 1d8 negative-energy damage plus 1 per four dread-necromancer levels to a living creature. The same touch instead heals an undead creature by 1 hit point plus 1 per four class levels and can be delivered through spectral hand.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Rebuke Undead
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Rebuke or command undead by channeling negative energy, using the cleric rebuke-undead class feature rules.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Lich Body
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Gain damage reduction 2/bludgeoning and magic at 2nd level. The reduction improves to 4 at 7th, 6 at 11th, and 8 at 15th level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Negative Energy Burst
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Emit a 5-foot burst of negative energy that deals 1d4 damage per class level to living creatures and heals undead by the same amount; a Will save with DC 10 + half class level + Charisma modifier halves the damage. Uses increase from 1/day at 3rd to 2/day at 8th, 3/day at 13th, and 4/day at 18th.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Advanced Learning
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th level, add one eligible necromancy spell from the cleric or wizard list to your dread-necromancer spell list. The spell cannot exceed the highest spell level you already know; if it appears on both lists at different levels, use the lower level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Mental Bastion
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Gain +2 on saving throws against sleep, stunning, paralysis, poison, and disease. The bonus improves to +4 at 14th level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Fear Aura
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: As a free action, radiate a 5-foot fear aura. Enemies in the area must make a Will save with DC 10 + half class level + Charisma modifier or become shaken; a creature that succeeds is immune to your fear aura for 24 hours.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Scabrous Touch
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: As a swift action, charge your Charnel Touch to inflict a disease as contagion on the next successful touch, with no incubation period and a Fortitude save of DC 10 + half class level + Charisma modifier. Uses increase from 1/day at 6th to 2/day at 11th and 3/day at 16th.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Summon Familiar
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: At 7th level or later, obtain one evil familiar chosen from imp, quasit, vargouille, or ghostly visage. It receives the source-listed familiar benefits and can deliver your touch abilities; full familiar statistics remain a companion-state subsystem.

omitAbilities: Speak with Animals of Its Kind

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Undead Mastery
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Undead you create gain +4 enhancement bonuses to Strength and Dexterity and +2 hit points per Hit Die. Animate dead control capacity becomes (4 + Charisma bonus) HD per class level, and control undead can target (2 + Charisma bonus) HD per level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Negative Energy Resistance
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Gain +4 on saving throws against negative-energy effects, including energy drain, some ability drain, and inflict spells.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Light Fortification
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: Gain 25% resistance to critical hits at 10th level. The fortification improves to 50% at 17th level.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Enervating Touch

resource.recoveryText: The daily negative-level pool refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: As a swift action, charge your Charnel Touch to bestow negative levels on the next successful touch. Your daily pool equals half your dread-necromancer level, with no more than two negative levels delivered by one touch; the removal save uses DC 10 + half class level + Charisma modifier.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Lich Transformation
classes/dread-necromancer-75.description: At 20th level, if you are humanoid, your type changes to undead and you gain the source-listed undead traits; existing Hit Dice become d12s and hit points are rerolled. The class removes the normal XP/gold cost for creating the required phylactery.

classes/druid-92.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/druid-92.description: Proficient with the club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, shortspear, sling, spear, and the natural attacks of wild-shaped forms. Proficient with light and medium nonmetal armor and nonmetal shields except tower shields; prohibited metal armor or shields suppress druid spellcasting and supernatural/spell-like class abilities while worn and for 24 hours afterward.

classes/druid-92.name: Spells
classes/druid-92.description: Prepare and cast divine spells from the druid list. Wisdom determines the highest spell level you can prepare or cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Druids prepare spells during daily meditation and do not receive cleric domains.

classes/druid-92.name: Spontaneous Casting
classes/druid-92.description: Sacrifice a prepared non-domain druid spell to cast a summon nature's ally spell of the same spell level or lower without having prepared that summoning spell.

classes/druid-92.name: Chaotic, Evil, Good, and Lawful Spells
classes/druid-92.description: You cannot cast a spell with an alignment descriptor opposed to your own alignment or your deity's alignment, if you have a deity.

classes/druid-92.name: Bonus Languages
classes/druid-92.description: Sylvan is available as a druid bonus-language choice. You also learn Druidic for free at 1st level; it does not use a normal language slot and may not be taught to nondruids.

classes/druid-92.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Choose an animal companion from the Druid list. Standard companions are always available; stronger alternatives unlock at effective druid levels 4, 7, 10, 13, and 16 and reduce the level used for companion abilities by 3, 6, 9, 12, or 15 respectively. The companion gains bonus Hit Dice, natural armor, Strength/Dexterity, bonus tricks, and abilities from the Druid companion progression. Replacing a released or lost companion requires 24 uninterrupted hours of prayer.

classes/druid-92.name: Nature Sense (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Gain +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.

classes/druid-92.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Improve an animal's attitude with a wild-empathy check of 1d20 + druid level + Charisma modifier. The creature normally must be within 30 feet and able to study you. You can also influence an Intelligence 1 or 2 magical beast with a -4 penalty.

classes/druid-92.name: Woodland Stride (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment. Magically manipulated undergrowth still affects you.

classes/druid-92.name: Trackless Step (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Leave no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked there unless you choose to leave a trail.

classes/druid-92.name: Resist Nature’s Lure (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: Gain +4 on saving throws against the spell-like abilities of fey.

classes/druid-92.name: Wild Shape (Su)
classes/druid-92.description: At 5th level, change into a familiar Small or Medium animal and back once per day. Changing form is a standard action and the form lasts up to 1 hour per druid level or until you revert. Uses per day, allowed sizes, and eligible creature types improve at the source-listed druid levels.

classes/druid-92.name: A Thousand Faces (Su)
classes/druid-92.description: Change your physical appearance at will as disguise self, affecting your body but not your possessions; this is a physical alteration rather than an illusion.

classes/druid-92.name: Timeless Body (Ex)
classes/druid-92.description: You no longer take new ability-score penalties from aging and cannot be magically aged. Existing penalties remain, aging bonuses still accrue, and you still die of old age. Violating core druid alignment/nature/Druidic obligations can cause loss of druid spells and abilities until atonement.

classes/druid-92.name: Animal Companion Basics
classes/druid-92.description: Animal companion abilities use the Druid progression. At effective druid levels 1-2 the companion gains Link and Share Spells; at 3rd it gains Evasion, at 6th Devotion, at 9th Multiattack, and at 15th Improved Evasion. Bonus HD, natural armor, Strength/Dexterity, and bonus tricks improve at the printed level bands.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/duskblade-102.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Spells
classes/duskblade-102.description: Cast arcane spells from the duskblade list using Intelligence. Intelligence determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day, and duskblade caster level equals class level.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Spells Known
classes/duskblade-102.description: Begin with two 0-level and two 1st-level duskblade spells known plus one additional 0-level spell per point of Intelligence bonus. Learn one additional spell you can cast at every new duskblade level. Beginning at 5th level and on later odd-numbered levels, you may replace one known spell under the source's same-level and maximum-level restrictions. Duskblade spells are cast spontaneously rather than prepared.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Arcane Attunement

resource.recoveryText: Arcane Attunement uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/duskblade-102.description: Use dancing lights, detect magic, flare, ghost sound, or read magic as spell-like abilities a combined total of 3 + Intelligence modifier times per day. These uses do not count against spells known or spells per day.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Armored Mage
classes/duskblade-102.description: Ignore arcane spell failure for duskblade spells in light armor and with light shields. At 4th level, medium armor also qualifies; at 7th, heavy shields also qualify. The benefit does not apply to arcane spells from other classes.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Combat Casting
classes/duskblade-102.description: Gain Combat Casting as a bonus feat at 2nd level.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Arcane Channeling
classes/duskblade-102.description: Beginning at 3rd level, as a standard action cast a touch spell with casting time 1 standard action or less and deliver it through a melee weapon attack without the casting itself provoking attacks of opportunity. At 13th level, you may instead channel a qualifying touch spell as part of a full attack, applying it to each target you hit that round.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Quick Cast
classes/duskblade-102.description: Cast one qualifying standard-action-or-faster spell as a swift action. Uses increase from 1/day at 5th level to 2/day at 10th, 3/day at 15th, and 4/day at 20th.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Spell Power
classes/duskblade-102.description: After you damage an opponent with a melee attack, gain a bonus on caster-level checks to overcome that opponent's spell resistance for the rest of the encounter. The bonus is +2 at 6th level, +3 at 11th, +4 at 16th, and +5 at 18th.

classes/expert-33.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/expert-33.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields. The Expert also chooses any ten skills to be class skills; that class-skill selection is handled separately from this feature reminder.

classes/expert2-124.name: Base Save Bonuses
classes/expert2-124.description: Use two good save progressions and one poor save progression, as defined by the generic Expert class.

classes/expert2-124.name: Class Skills
classes/expert2-124.description: Choose any twelve skills as class skills; Craft and Profession are also class skills.

classes/expert2-124.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/expert2-124.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, one chosen martial weapon, and light armor.

classes/expert2-124.name: Bonus Feats
classes/expert2-124.description: Gain one bonus feat at 1st, 2nd, and 4th level, then another every four class levels through 20th.

classes/factotum-35.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/factotum-35.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields. Factotum Arcane Dilettante abilities function as spell-like abilities, so armor does not impose arcane spell failure on them.

classes/factotum-35.name: Inspiration

resource.recoveryText: Refresh the Inspiration pool to its maximum at the beginning of each encounter.

classes/factotum-35.description: At the beginning of each encounter, gain the class-table number of inspiration points. Many factotum abilities spend points from this shared encounter pool; the pool is 2 at 1st level, 3 at 2nd, 4 at 5th, 5 at 8th, 6 at 11th, 7 at 14th, 8 at 17th, and 10 at 20th.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Insight
classes/factotum-35.description: Before an attack roll, damage roll, or saving throw, spend 1 inspiration point to add your Intelligence modifier as a competence bonus. It requires no action and can be used repeatedly while inspiration remains, but the competence bonus does not stack with itself.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Knowledge
classes/factotum-35.description: When making a check with a skill in which you have at least 1 rank, spend 1 inspiration point to add your factotum level to the check. You can use Cunning Knowledge only once per day for any particular skill, though different skills can each receive the benefit.

classes/factotum-35.name: Trapfinding
classes/factotum-35.description: Use Search to locate traps with DC above 20 and Disable Device to bypass or disarm magic traps, following the standard Trapfinding rules.

classes/factotum-35.name: Arcane Dilettante
classes/factotum-35.description: Spend 1 inspiration point to use one of your daily Arcane Dilettante spells as a spell-like ability. After daily rest, prepare the class-table number of distinct sorcerer/wizard spells up to the listed maximum spell level, with no more than one spell at that maximum level. Each prepared spell can be used once before the next 8-hour rest, uses factotum level as caster level, Intelligence for save DCs, cannot require an XP cost, and may have metamagic applied only if the modified level is within your allowed spell level.

classes/factotum-35.name: Brains over Brawn
classes/factotum-35.description: Add your Intelligence bonus to Strength checks, Dexterity checks, and skill checks based on Strength or Dexterity.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Defense
classes/factotum-35.description: Spend 1 inspiration point as a free action to add your Intelligence bonus as a dodge bonus to AC against one opponent for 1 round. You may use it against multiple opponents, but not more than once during your turn against the same foe.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Strike
classes/factotum-35.description: Before making an attack roll, spend 1 inspiration point to gain +1d6 sneak attack damage for that attack. For interactions with uncanny dodge, use your factotum level as your rogue level.

classes/factotum-35.name: Opportunistic Piety

resource.recoveryText: Opportunistic Piety daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery; each use also costs 1 inspiration point.

classes/factotum-35.description: Spend 1 inspiration point and one daily use as a standard action to channel divine energy. Heal a living creature or damage an undead creature for twice your factotum level + Intelligence modifier, or turn undead as a cleric of your factotum level. Daily uses equal 3 + positive Wisdom bonus at 5th level, with one additional base use at 10th, 15th, and 20th.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Surge
classes/factotum-35.description: During your turn, spend 3 inspiration points to gain one extra standard action.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Breach
classes/factotum-35.description: Spend 2 inspiration points as a free action to ignore one target's spell resistance and damage reduction for 1 round.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Dodge

resource.recoveryText: Cunning Dodge's once-per-day use refreshes with the character's daily recovery; activation also costs 4 inspiration points.

classes/factotum-35.description: Once per day, if damage would reduce you to 0 or fewer hit points, spend 4 inspiration points as an immediate action to ignore that damage.

classes/factotum-35.name: Improved Cunning Defense
classes/factotum-35.description: Add your Intelligence bonus as a continuous dodge bonus to AC without spending inspiration. Unlike Cunning Defense, this benefit does not apply while wearing medium or heavy armor.

classes/factotum-35.name: Cunning Brilliance

resource.recoveryText: At the start of each day, designate three eligible extraordinary class abilities; each designated ability can be activated once that day and costs 4 inspiration points.

classes/factotum-35.description: At the start of each day, designate three extraordinary class abilities available to a standard class by 15th level or lower. Spend 4 inspiration points as a free action to gain one designated ability's benefits and drawbacks for 1 minute as though your relevant class level equaled your factotum level. Each designated ability can be used once that day.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/favored-soul-7.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields, plus your deity's favored weapon. Heavy armor is not a favored-soul proficiency, but wearing it does not interfere with favored-soul spellcasting.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Spells
classes/favored-soul-7.description: Cast divine spells spontaneously from the cleric list. Charisma determines spell access, spells per day, and bonus spells; Wisdom determines favored-soul spell save DCs. Begin with a fixed number of spells known and gain more with class level. Starting at 4th level and every even favored-soul level thereafter, you may replace one known spell under the source's same-level and maximum-level restrictions.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Deity’s Weapon Focus
classes/favored-soul-7.description: At 3rd level, gain Weapon Focus with your deity's favored weapon. Record the specific Weapon Focus feat for that favored weapon; if you already have it, the source allows a different feat instead.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Energy Resistance
classes/favored-soul-7.description: At 5th level choose one energy type and gain resistance 10 to it. At 10th and 15th level choose a different energy type each time and gain resistance 10 to each new type.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Deity’s Weapon Specialization
classes/favored-soul-7.description: At 12th level, gain Weapon Specialization with your deity's favored weapon. Record the specific Weapon Specialization feat for that favored weapon; if you already have it, the source allows a different feat instead.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Wings
classes/favored-soul-7.description: Gain wings and a 60-foot fly speed with good maneuverability. Good-aligned favored souls grow feathered wings, evil-aligned favored souls grow batlike wings, and neutral favored souls may choose either form.

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Damage Reduction
classes/favored-soul-7.description: Gain damage reduction 10/silver if lawful or 10/cold iron if chaotic. A favored soul that is neither lawful nor chaotic may choose either form of damage reduction.

classes/fighter-93.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/fighter-93.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields including tower shields.

classes/fighter-93.name: Bonus Feats
classes/fighter-93.description: Gain a fighter bonus feat at 1st level, another at 2nd level, and one every two fighter levels thereafter through 20th. Each choice must come from the fighter bonus feat list and you must meet its prerequisites. These are in addition to normal level-based feats.

classes/healer-77.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/healer-77.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor. Wearing metal armor or using any shield violates the healer's oath, suppressing healer spellcasting and supernatural/spell-like class features while worn and for 24 hours afterward.

classes/healer-77.name: Spells
classes/healer-77.description: Prepare divine spells from the healer list using Wisdom. Wisdom determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day. After one hour of daily meditation or prayer, choose prepared spells from any healer-list spells of levels you can cast.

classes/healer-77.name: Healing Hands
classes/healer-77.description: When a healer spell of the healing subschool cures hit point damage, add your Charisma modifier to the amount healed. This applies only to healing-subschooled spells cast as a healer.

classes/healer-77.name: Skill Focus (Heal)
classes/healer-77.description: Gain Skill Focus (Heal) as a bonus feat at 2nd level. If you already have that feat, the source allows a different feat instead.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Paralysis

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Paralysis refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, remove paralysis as though using remove paralysis.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Disease

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Disease refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, remove disease as though using remove disease.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Fear

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Fear refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, remove fear as though using remove fear.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Poison

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Poison refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, neutralize poison as though using neutralize poison.

classes/healer-77.name: Effortless Healing
classes/healer-77.description: Cast healer spells of the healing subschool without provoking attacks of opportunity. This benefit applies only to healing-subschooled spells cast as a healer.

classes/healer-77.name: Unicorn Companion

resource.recoveryText: The daily companion call refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day as a full-round action, call your celestial unicorn companion. It appears adjacent to you and remains for 2 hours per healer level unless dismissed earlier. At 12th level or higher, you may instead select Lammasu, Gynosphinx, Water Naga, Androsphinx, or Couatl; the alternative uses the source-listed effective-level adjustment (-4 for Lammasu/Gynosphinx/Water Naga, -8 for Androsphinx/Couatl).

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Blindness

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Blindness refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, remove blindness or deafness as though using remove blindness/deafness.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Spirit

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Spirit refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, restore a creature as though using greater restoration.

classes/healer-77.name: Cleanse Petrification

resource.recoveryText: Cleanse Petrification refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, restore a petrified creature as though using stone to flesh.

classes/healer-77.name: New Limb

resource.recoveryText: New Limb refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per day, regrow lost or damaged body parts as though using regenerate.

classes/healer-77.name: New Life

resource.recoveryText: New Life can be used once per week; track the seven-day recovery manually.

classes/healer-77.description: Once per week, return a dead creature to life as though using true resurrection.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/hexblade-19.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons and light armor, but not shields. Hexblade spells can be cast in light armor without arcane spell failure; medium/heavy armor or a shield can impose normal arcane spell failure, and multiclass arcane spells use their own normal armor rules.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Hexblade’s Curse
classes/hexblade-19.description: As a free action, curse one visible foe within 60 feet. The target takes -2 on attacks, saves, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage for 1 hour unless it succeeds on a Will save with DC 10 + half hexblade level + Charisma modifier. Uses increase from 1/day at 1st level to 2/day at 5th, 3/day at 9th, 4/day at 13th, and 5/day at 17th. A target that successfully saves cannot be affected by your curse again for 24 hours.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Arcane Resistance
classes/hexblade-19.description: Add your Charisma bonus, minimum +1, to saving throws against spells and spell-like effects.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Mettle
classes/hexblade-19.description: If you succeed on a Fortitude or Will save against an effect that normally has a reduced effect on a successful save, negate that effect completely. Mettle does not function while you are unconscious or asleep.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Familiar
classes/hexblade-19.description: Beginning at 4th level, you can obtain a familiar using the source's familiar rules. Treat your hexblade level as three lower when determining familiar abilities. A multiclass character can still have only one familiar at a time; full familiar state remains part of the companion subsystem.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Spells
classes/hexblade-19.description: Beginning at 4th level, cast a limited number of arcane hexblade spells spontaneously using Charisma. A printed 0 spells/day means that spell level is available only through applicable bonus spells. Caster level is one-half hexblade level once spellcasting begins, and the source permits limited same-level spell replacement at 12th, 15th, and 18th level.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Bonus Feat
classes/hexblade-19.description: At 5th level and every five levels thereafter, choose one hexblade bonus feat from the source list: Combat Casting; Spell Focus or Greater Spell Focus for enchantment, necromancy, or transmutation; Spell Penetration; or Greater Spell Penetration. You must meet any normal prerequisites.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Greater Hexblade’s Curse
classes/hexblade-19.description: At 7th level, the penalty imposed by Hexblade’s Curse improves from -2 to -4.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Aura of Unluck

resource.recoveryText: Daily Aura of Unluck uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/hexblade-19.description: As a free action, create an aura that gives attacks against you a 20% miss chance for 3 + your Charisma bonus rounds. You can use it once per day at 12th level, twice per day at 16th, and three times per day at 20th.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Dire Hexblade’s Curse
classes/hexblade-19.description: At 19th level, the penalty imposed by Hexblade’s Curse improves from -4 to -6.

classes/knight-103.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/knight-103.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/knight-103.name: Knight’s Challenge

resource.recoveryText: Knight’s Challenge uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/knight-103.description: Gain a shared daily Knight’s Challenge pool equal to one-half your knight level plus your Charisma modifier, minimum one use per day. Fighting Challenge and later challenge options spend uses from this same pool.

classes/knight-103.name: Fighting Challenge
classes/knight-103.description: As a swift action, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to challenge one eligible foe. Against that foe, gain a morale bonus on Will saves, attack rolls, and damage rolls for 5 + Charisma modifier rounds. The bonus is +1 at 1st level, +2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, and +4 at 19th.

classes/knight-103.name: Test of Mettle
classes/knight-103.description: As a swift action, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to challenge eligible enemies within 100 feet. Foes of sufficient CR that fail a Will save against DC 10 + half knight level + Charisma modifier must prefer attacking you while the effect lasts, subject to the source's targeting and once-per-day-per-creature limits.

classes/knight-103.name: Call to Battle
classes/knight-103.description: As a swift action, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to let an ally attempt another saving throw against a fear effect, adding your Charisma bonus to that save. A successful new save immediately ends the fear effect as though the original save had succeeded.

classes/knight-103.name: Daunting Challenge
classes/knight-103.description: As a swift action, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to force eligible lower-CR enemies within 100 feet to make a Will save against DC 10 + half knight level + Charisma modifier or become shaken. Each creature can be targeted by this effect only once per day.

classes/knight-103.name: Bond of Loyalty
classes/knight-103.description: Once per round as a free action, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to attempt an additional saving throw against a mind-affecting spell or ability, even if that effect is controlling your actions.

classes/knight-103.name: Loyal Beyond Death
classes/knight-103.description: When reduced to 0 or fewer hit points while your body remains intact, spend one Knight’s Challenge use to remain conscious and continue acting for 1 more round. You can spend additional uses round by round until healed above the source's death threshold or the pool runs out.

classes/knight-103.name: Knight’s Code
classes/knight-103.description: Follow the knightly code: forgo your own flanking attack bonus, do not strike flat-footed opponents, and do not deal lethal damage to helpless foes. Violating the code costs one Knight’s Challenge use for the day; if none remain, take the source-listed attack/save penalty for the rest of the day.

classes/knight-103.name: Mounted Combat
classes/knight-103.description: Gain Mounted Combat as a bonus feat at 2nd level.

classes/knight-103.name: Shield Block
classes/knight-103.description: During your action, designate one opponent. Your shield bonus to AC against that foe increases by +1 at 2nd level, +2 at 11th, and +3 at 20th.

classes/knight-103.name: Bulwark of Defense
classes/knight-103.description: An opponent that begins its turn in your threatened area treats all squares you threaten as difficult terrain.

classes/knight-103.name: Armor Mastery
classes/knight-103.description: Ignore the normal speed reduction from medium armor beginning at 4th level and from heavy armor beginning at 9th level.

classes/knight-103.name: Bonus Feat
classes/knight-103.description: At 5th, 10th, and 15th level, choose one bonus feat from the knight's source list. You must meet the feat's normal prerequisites.

classes/knight-103.name: Vigilant Defender
classes/knight-103.description: Increase the Tumble DC for opponents attempting to move through your threatened area or your space without provoking attacks of opportunity by an amount equal to your knight level.

classes/knight-103.name: Shield Ally
classes/knight-103.description: As an immediate action, choose to absorb half the physical melee or ranged attack damage dealt to an adjacent ally before your next turn, following the source's restrictions.

classes/knight-103.name: Improved Shield Ally
classes/knight-103.description: Once per round, absorb all damage from one physical attack against an adjacent ally, while retaining the option to absorb half the damage from other qualifying physical attacks as Shield Ally allows.

classes/knight-103.name: Impetuous Endurance
classes/knight-103.description: You no longer automatically fail a saving throw when the d20 shows a natural 1; the save still fails if the total result does not meet the DC.

classes/magewright-1029.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/magewright-1029.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, but not armor or shields. Armor can cause arcane spell failure for magewright spells with somatic components.

classes/magewright-1029.name: Spells
classes/magewright-1029.description: Prepare arcane spells ahead of time. Intelligence determines spell save DCs and bonus spells. Magewrights do not use spellbooks and cannot learn spells from spellbooks or scrolls; a printed 0 on the progression grants only applicable bonus spells.

classes/magewright-1029.name: Spell Mastery
classes/magewright-1029.description: Prepare a limited mastered spell repertoire without a spellbook. Begin with mastered spells equal to Intelligence modifier, then learn another Intelligence-modifier number of spells plus one 0-level spell whenever a new spell level is gained and again at 20th level.

classes/marshal-78.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/marshal-78.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/marshal-78.name: Auras
classes/marshal-78.description: Project one known minor aura and, from 2nd level onward, one known major aura at the same time. Activating an aura is a swift action; dismissing it or replacing another aura of the same kind is a free action. Unless noted otherwise, an aura affects allies within 60 feet who can hear and understand you, and its circumstance bonus does not stack with other marshal aura bonuses.

classes/marshal-78.name: Minor Aura
classes/marshal-78.description: Each time your minor-auras-known count increases, choose another minor aura. A minor aura lets affected allies add your Charisma bonus to the source-listed category of rolls. You know 1 minor aura at 1st level and eventually 8 at 19th level.

Accurate Strike.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) to rolls made to confirm critical hits.

Art of War.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on disarm, trip, bull rush, and sunder attempts.

Demand Fortitude.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Fortitude saves.

Determined Caster.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on rolls to overcome spell resistance.

Force of Will.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Will saves.

Master of Opportunity.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity.

Master of Tactics.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on damage rolls when flanking.

Motivate Charisma.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks.

Motivate Constitution.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Constitution checks and Constitution-based skill checks.

Motivate Dexterity.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Dexterity checks, Dexterity-based skill checks, and initiative checks.

Motivate Intelligence.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks.

Motivate Strength.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks.

Motivate Wisdom.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Wisdom checks and Wisdom-based skill checks.

Over the Top.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on damage rolls when charging.

Watchful Eye.description: Affected allies add your Charisma bonus (if any) on Reflex saves.

classes/marshal-78.name: Major Aura
classes/marshal-78.description: Each time your major-auras-known count increases, choose another major aura. The major aura bonus is +1 at 2nd level, +2 at 7th, +3 at 14th, and +4 at 20th. You know 1 major aura at 2nd level and eventually 5 at 20th level.

Hardy Soldiers.description: Affected allies gain damage reduction X/-, where X is your current major-aura bonus (+1 at 2nd level, +2 at 7th, +3 at 14th, +4 at 20th).

Motivate Ardor.description: Affected allies gain a circumstance bonus on damage rolls equal to your current major-aura bonus.

Motivate Attack.description: Affected allies gain a circumstance bonus on melee attack rolls equal to your current major-aura bonus.

Motivate Care.description: Affected allies gain a circumstance bonus to Armor Class equal to your current major-aura bonus.

Motivate Urgency.description: Affected allies increase base land speed by 5 feet × your current major-aura bonus.

Resilient Troops.description: Affected allies gain a circumstance bonus on all saving throws equal to your current major-aura bonus.

Steady Hand.description: Affected allies gain a circumstance bonus on ranged attack rolls equal to your current major-aura bonus.

classes/marshal-78.name: Skill Focus (Diplomacy)
classes/marshal-78.description: Gain Skill Focus (Diplomacy) as a bonus feat. If you already have that exact feat, the source permits choosing a different feat instead.

classes/marshal-78.name: Grant Move Action
classes/marshal-78.description: As a standard action, grant an immediate extra move action to any or all allies within 30 feet, but not yourself. Uses increase from 1/day at 4th level to 2/day at 8th, 3/day at 12th, 4/day at 16th, and 5/day at 20th. A creature can benefit from only one such extra move action in a round.

resource.recoveryText: Grant Move Action uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/monk-94.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/monk-94.description: Proficient with the club, light or heavy crossbow, dagger, handaxe, javelin, kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, shuriken, siangham, and sling. Monks are not proficient with armor or shields; armor, shields, and medium or heavy loads also disable several monk abilities.

classes/monk-94.name: AC Bonus (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: While unarmored and unencumbered, add your Wisdom bonus to AC. You also gain +1 AC at 5th level and another +1 every five monk levels thereafter, to +4 at 20th. These bonuses apply to touch AC and while flat-footed, but are lost while immobilized or helpless or while using armor, a shield, or a medium/heavy load.

classes/monk-94.name: Flurry of Blows (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: When unarmored, use a full attack to make one extra attack at your highest base attack bonus, with the flurry penalty applied to every attack that round. The penalty is -2 initially, -1 at 5th, and disappears at 9th. Flurry uses unarmed strikes or special monk weapons; at 11th level it gains a second extra attack at the full base attack bonus.

classes/monk-94.name: Unarmed Strike
classes/monk-94.description: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. Monk unarmed strikes can use any appropriate body part, apply full Strength to damage, may deal lethal or nonlethal damage without the usual penalty, count as both manufactured and natural weapons for effects that enhance either, and use the monk unarmed-damage progression.

classes/monk-94.name: Bonus Feat
classes/monk-94.description: Choose Improved Grapple or Stunning Fist at 1st level, Combat Reflexes or Deflect Arrows at 2nd, and Improved Disarm or Improved Trip at 6th. These monk bonus-feat choices ignore the feats' normal prerequisites.

classes/monk-94.name: Evasion (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: On a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage, take no damage instead. Evasion works only in light armor or no armor and does not function while helpless.

classes/monk-94.name: Fast Movement (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: Gain the enhancement bonus to speed shown on the monk progression. The bonus is lost while wearing armor or carrying a medium or heavy load.

classes/monk-94.name: Still Mind (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: Gain +2 on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

classes/monk-94.name: Ki Strike (Su)
classes/monk-94.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magic weapons for overcoming damage reduction at 4th level, also as lawful at 10th, and also as adamantine at 16th for damage reduction and hardness.

classes/monk-94.name: Slow Fall (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: When within reach of a wall, reduce the effective falling distance by 20 feet at 4th level. The reduction improves with monk level until 20th level, when a nearby wall lets you fall any distance without harm.

classes/monk-94.name: Purity of Body (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: Gain immunity to disease except supernatural and magical diseases.

classes/monk-94.name: Wholeness of Body (Su)

resource.recoveryText: Healing pool refreshes after the character's daily recovery; track the table's rest/timing requirements.

classes/monk-94.description: Heal your own wounds from a daily pool equal to twice your monk level. You may divide that healing among multiple uses.

classes/monk-94.name: Improved Evasion (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: Against effects covered by evasion, take no damage on a successful Reflex save and only half damage on a failed save. It does not function while helpless.

classes/monk-94.name: Diamond Body (Su)
classes/monk-94.description: Gain immunity to poison.

classes/monk-94.name: Abundant Step (Su)
classes/monk-94.description: Once per day, move between spaces as dimension door. The effect's caster level is one-half your monk level, rounded down.

classes/monk-94.name: Diamond Soul (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: Gain spell resistance equal to your monk level + 10.

classes/monk-94.name: Quivering Palm (Su)
classes/monk-94.description: Once per week, announce the ability before an attack. If the eligible target is hit and damaged, you can later attempt to slay it within a number of days equal to your monk level; the target survives on a Fortitude save with DC 10 + half monk level + Wisdom modifier. Several creature types and creatures immune to critical hits cannot be affected.

classes/monk-94.name: Timeless Body (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: You no longer take new ability-score penalties from aging and cannot be magically aged. Existing aging penalties remain, aging bonuses still accrue, and you still die of old age.

classes/monk-94.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)
classes/monk-94.description: You can speak with any living creature.

classes/monk-94.name: Empty Body (Su)

resource.recoveryText: Daily ethereal rounds refresh after the character's daily recovery.

classes/monk-94.description: Become ethereal as the etherealness spell for a total number of rounds per day equal to your monk level. The rounds can be split among multiple uses.

classes/monk-94.name: Perfect Self
classes/monk-94.description: You are treated as an outsider rather than a humanoid for spells and magical effects, gain damage reduction 10/magic, and can still be restored to life as your former creature type. A nonlawful monk cannot gain further monk levels. A monk who advances another class after becoming multiclass cannot later resume monk advancement.

classes/ninja-1.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/ninja-1.description: Proficient with all simple weapons plus hand crossbow, kama, kukri, nunchaku, sai, shortbow, short sword, shuriken, and siangham. Ninjas are not proficient with armor or shields.

classes/ninja-1.name: AC Bonus
classes/ninja-1.description: While unarmored and unencumbered, add your Wisdom bonus to AC. Gain an additional +1 class bonus at 5th level and another +1 every five ninja levels thereafter, to +4 at 20th. These bonuses apply to touch AC and while flat-footed but are lost while immobilized, helpless, armored, shielded, or carrying a medium/heavy load.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ki Power
classes/ninja-1.description: Gain a daily ki-use pool equal to one-half ninja level, minimum 1, plus Wisdom bonus. Ki abilities work only while unarmored and unencumbered. While at least one ki use remains, gain +2 on Will saves. Ghost Step, Ki Dodge, Ghost Strike, Greater Ki Dodge, and Ghost Walk spend this shared pool.

resource.recoveryText: The daily ki pool refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/ninja-1.name: Sudden Strike
classes/ninja-1.description: Deal +1d6 damage when a target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC; damage increases by +1d6 every two ninja levels. Ranged sudden strikes require a target within 30 feet. It does not work merely from flanking and fails against targets/effects that prevent precision damage.

classes/ninja-1.name: Trapfinding
classes/ninja-1.description: Use Search to locate traps with DC above 20 and Disable Device to bypass or disarm magic traps, using the same core rules as the rogue Trapfinding feature.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ghost Step
classes/ninja-1.description: Spend one ki use as a swift action to become invisible for 1 round. At 10th level, you may become ethereal instead of invisible.

classes/ninja-1.name: Poison Use
classes/ninja-1.description: You no longer risk accidentally poisoning yourself when applying poison to a weapon.

classes/ninja-1.name: Great Leap
classes/ninja-1.description: While unarmored and carrying no more than a light load, make Jump checks as though you had a running start and the Run feat, including the source-listed +4 jump benefit.

classes/ninja-1.name: Acrobatics
classes/ninja-1.description: Gain +2 on Climb, Jump, and Tumble checks at 6th level; this improves to +4 at 12th and +6 at 18th.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ki Dodge
classes/ninja-1.description: Spend one ki use as a swift action to gain concealment with a 20% miss chance against attacks for 1 round. True seeing negates the miss chance; the concealment does not stack with other concealment.

classes/ninja-1.name: Speed Climb
classes/ninja-1.description: While unarmored and carrying no more than a light load, climb at your speed as a move action without the normal penalty, provided you begin and end the round on a horizontal surface.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ghost Strike
classes/ninja-1.description: Spend one ki use as a move action to let your next attack, made before the end of your next turn, strike incorporeal and ethereal creatures normally; while ethereal, it also lets you strike Material Plane targets normally.

classes/ninja-1.name: Improved Poison Use
classes/ninja-1.description: Apply poison to a weapon as a move action instead of a standard action.

classes/ninja-1.name: Evasion
classes/ninja-1.description: On a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage, take no damage instead. Ninja Evasion functions only while unarmored and carrying no more than a light load.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ghost Mind
classes/ninja-1.description: Scrying-subschooled spells must pass a caster-level check against DC 20 + ninja level to detect or see you; failed targeted attempts fail entirely, while failed area scans simply fail to reveal you.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ghost Sight
classes/ninja-1.description: See invisible and ethereal creatures as easily as material creatures and objects.

classes/ninja-1.name: Greater Ki Dodge
classes/ninja-1.description: Your Ki Dodge improves from concealment to total concealment, producing a 50% miss chance.

classes/ninja-1.name: Ghost Walk
classes/ninja-1.description: Spend two ki uses to enter the Ethereal Plane as ethereal jaunt with caster level equal to ninja level.

classes/paladin-95.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/paladin-95.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/paladin-95.name: Aura of Good (Ex)
classes/paladin-95.description: Project a good-aligned aura whose power is based on your paladin level.

classes/paladin-95.name: Detect Evil (Sp)
classes/paladin-95.description: Use detect evil at will as a spell-like ability.

classes/paladin-95.name: Smite Evil (Su)
classes/paladin-95.description: Once per day at 1st level, declare a smite on one normal melee attack against an evil creature. Add your Charisma bonus to the attack roll and your paladin level to damage. A failed alignment match still expends the use. Gain another daily use at 5th level and every five paladin levels thereafter, to 5/day at 20th.

classes/paladin-95.name: Divine Grace (Su)
classes/paladin-95.description: Add your Charisma bonus, if any, to all saving throws.

classes/paladin-95.name: Lay on Hands (Su)
classes/paladin-95.description: With Charisma 12 or higher, gain a daily healing pool equal to paladin level × Charisma bonus. You can divide the pool among multiple uses. Using lay on hands is a standard action; against undead, you can instead spend points as damage with a successful melee touch attack.

classes/paladin-95.name: Aura of Courage (Su)
classes/paladin-95.description: Become immune to fear. While you are conscious, allies within 10 feet gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

classes/paladin-95.name: Divine Health
classes/paladin-95.description: Gain immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.

classes/paladin-95.name: Turn Undead (Su)
classes/paladin-95.description: Turn undead as a cleric three levels lower than your paladin level. You can use this ability 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day.

classes/paladin-95.name: Spells
classes/paladin-95.description: Beginning at 4th level, prepare and cast divine spells from the paladin list. Wisdom determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells per day. A printed 0 on the progression means the spell level is available only through applicable bonus spells.

classes/paladin-95.name: Special Mount (Sp)
