classes/paladin-95.description: Gain the service of a special mount. Once per day, as a full-round action, call the same mount to appear adjacent to you for up to 2 hours per paladin level. The mount progresses with paladin level and has the special abilities described by the class rules.

classes/paladin-95.name: Remove Disease (Sp)
classes/paladin-95.description: Produce remove disease as a spell-like ability once per week at 6th level, gaining one additional weekly use every three paladin levels thereafter.

classes/paladin-95.name: Code of Conduct
classes/paladin-95.description: A paladin must remain lawful good, avoid willingly committing evil acts, respect legitimate authority, act honorably, help those in need when doing so does not serve evil or chaos, and punish those who threaten innocents. Violating the class's fall conditions can remove paladin abilities until atonement.

classes/paladin-95.name: Associates
classes/paladin-95.description: Do not knowingly associate with evil characters or continue with companions who consistently violate the paladin's moral code; henchmen, followers, and cohorts must be lawful good. The class also carries the 3.5 multiclass restriction described by the source.

classes/paladin-95.name: Paladin’s Mount Basics
classes/paladin-95.description: The special mount uses its base creature statistics plus the paladin-mount progression: bonus Hit Dice, natural armor and Strength adjustments, increased Intelligence, and additional special abilities such as empathic link as the paladin advances.

classes/psion-137.name: Class Skills
classes/psion-137.description: Your chosen psionic discipline adds class skills. Seer adds Gather Information, Listen, and Spot; Shaper adds Bluff, Disguise, and Use Psionic Device; Kineticist adds Autohypnosis, Disable Device, and Intimidate; Egoist adds Autohypnosis, Balance, and Heal; Nomad adds Climb, Jump, Ride, Survival, and Swim; Telepath adds Bluff, Diplomacy, Gather Information, and Sense Motive.

classes/psion-137.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/psion-137.description: Proficient with the club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, quarterstaff, and shortspear. Psions are not proficient with armor or shields, and armor does not interfere with manifesting powers.

classes/psion-137.name: Power Points/Day
classes/psion-137.description: Manifesting powers spends power points. Your base daily power-point allotment follows the Psion progression table, and a high Intelligence score can grant bonus power points; race, feats, and items can also add power points.

classes/psion-137.name: Discipline
classes/psion-137.description: Choose one psionic discipline at 1st level. It grants its associated class skills and access to powers restricted to that discipline; you cannot normally learn powers restricted to the other disciplines.

classes/psion-137.name: Powers Known
classes/psion-137.description: Begin with three psion powers known and learn additional powers as you gain levels. You may choose general psion powers and powers from your chosen discipline, but not powers restricted to other disciplines unless another rule allows it. You do not prepare powers; after a good night's rest you regain spent power points. A power's save DC is 10 + power level + Intelligence modifier.

classes/psion-137.name: Maximum Power Level Known
classes/psion-137.description: The highest-level power you can learn increases with Psion level according to the class table. To learn or manifest a power, your Intelligence score must be at least 10 + the power's level.

classes/psion-137.name: Bonus Feats
classes/psion-137.description: Gain a bonus feat at 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level. Each of these class bonus feats must be a psionic feat, metapsionic feat, or psionic item creation feat; they are in addition to normal character-level feats.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/psychic-warrior-138.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Power Points/Day
classes/psychic-warrior-138.description: Use a daily power-point reserve to manifest psychic-warrior powers. Base power points follow the class table, with bonus power points from a high Wisdom score and other valid sources. A 1st-level psychic warrior has 0 base class power points but can still manifest the power known if bonus power points provide a reserve.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Powers Known
classes/psychic-warrior-138.description: Know one psychic-warrior power at 1st level and gain another power known at each new psychic-warrior level. Powers normally come from the psychic-warrior list, require no daily preparation, and can be manifested repeatedly while sufficient power points remain. Wisdom sets save DCs and bonus power points.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Maximum Power Level Known
classes/psychic-warrior-138.description: Begin with access to 1st-level powers. The highest power level available increases according to the class table, reaching 6th-level powers at 16th level. Learning or manifesting a power also requires Wisdom of at least 10 + the power's level.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Bonus Feats
classes/psychic-warrior-138.description: Choose a bonus combat-oriented feat at 1st and 2nd level and again at 5th, 8th, 11th, 14th, 17th, and 20th. Eligible choices are fighter bonus feats or psionic feats, and normal prerequisites still apply; fighter-level-specific feats still require the necessary fighter levels.

classes/ranger-96.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/ranger-96.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/ranger-96.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Select a favored-enemy creature type at 1st level. Gain +2 on the source-listed Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against that enemy and +2 weapon damage against it. At 5th level and every five ranger levels thereafter, select another favored enemy and increase one favored-enemy bonus by +2. Humanoid and outsider choices require the appropriate subtype.

classes/ranger-96.name: Track
classes/ranger-96.description: Gain Track as a bonus feat.

classes/ranger-96.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Improve an animal's attitude with a wild-empathy check of 1d20 + ranger level + Charisma modifier. The creature normally must be within 30 feet and able to study you. You can also influence an Intelligence 1 or 2 magical beast with a -4 penalty.

classes/ranger-96.name: Combat Style (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Choose Archery or Two-Weapon Combat at 2nd level. Archery grants the class benefit equivalent to Rapid Shot; Two-Weapon Combat grants the class benefit equivalent to Two-Weapon Fighting. The combat-style benefits ignore normal feat prerequisites but function only in light armor or no armor.

classes/ranger-96.name: Endurance
classes/ranger-96.description: Gain Endurance as a bonus feat at 3rd level.

classes/ranger-96.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: At 4th level, gain an animal companion using the druid companion progression, but your effective druid level is one-half your ranger level. Standard Ranger choices include the source-listed land animals; in an aquatic campaign the DM may also allow crocodile, porpoise, Medium shark, and squid. Stronger alternatives use the normal source-listed effective-level adjustments.

classes/ranger-96.name: Spells
classes/ranger-96.description: Beginning at 4th level, prepare and cast divine spells from the ranger list. Wisdom determines spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells. A printed 0 on the progression means that level is available only through applicable bonus spells. Ranger caster level is one-half ranger level once spellcasting begins.

classes/ranger-96.name: Improved Combat Style (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: At 6th level, the Archery style gains the class benefit equivalent to Manyshot, while Two-Weapon Combat gains the class benefit equivalent to Improved Two-Weapon Fighting. Normal prerequisites are ignored, and the benefit still requires light armor or no armor.

classes/ranger-96.name: Woodland Stride (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment. Enchanted or magically manipulated undergrowth can still impede you.

classes/ranger-96.name: Swift Tracker (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Follow tracks at normal speed without the usual -5 penalty, and take only -10 instead of -20 when tracking at up to twice normal speed.

classes/ranger-96.name: Evasion (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: On a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage, take no damage instead. Ranger evasion works only in light armor or no armor and does not function while helpless.

classes/ranger-96.name: Combat Style Mastery (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: At 11th level, the Archery style gains the class benefit equivalent to Improved Precise Shot, while Two-Weapon Combat gains the class benefit equivalent to Greater Two-Weapon Fighting. Normal prerequisites are ignored, and the benefit still requires light armor or no armor.

classes/ranger-96.name: Camouflage (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: Use Hide in natural terrain even when that terrain does not provide cover or concealment.

classes/ranger-96.name: Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)
classes/ranger-96.description: While in natural terrain, use Hide even while being observed.

classes/rogue-97.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/rogue-97.description: Proficient with all simple weapons plus the hand crossbow, rapier, sap, shortbow, and short sword. Proficient with light armor, but not shields.

classes/rogue-97.name: Sneak Attack
classes/rogue-97.description: Deal +1d6 damage when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or when you flank it; the bonus increases by +1d6 every two rogue levels. Ranged sneak attacks require the target to be within 30 feet. Sneak-attack dice are not multiplied on a critical hit, and the attack requires a target with a vulnerable anatomy that you can see and reach without concealment.

classes/rogue-97.name: Trapfinding
classes/rogue-97.description: You can use Search to find traps with DCs above 20 and Disable Device to disarm magic traps. Beating a trap's Disable Device DC by 10 or more lets you understand and bypass it for your party without disarming it.

classes/rogue-97.name: Evasion (Ex)
classes/rogue-97.description: When you succeed on a Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage on a successful save, you instead take no damage. Evasion works only in light armor or no armor and does not function while you are helpless.

classes/rogue-97.name: Trap Sense (Ex)
classes/rogue-97.description: Gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps and +1 dodge AC against trap attacks. Both bonuses increase by +1 at 6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th rogue level, and trap-sense bonuses from multiple classes stack.

classes/rogue-97.name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
classes/rogue-97.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or when attacked by an invisible opponent, unless you are immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, you gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

classes/rogue-97.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
classes/rogue-97.description: You can no longer be flanked, except by a rogue whose rogue level is at least four higher than your effective level for this ability. Levels from classes that grant uncanny dodge stack for this purpose.

classes/rogue-97.name: Special Abilities
classes/rogue-97.description: At 10th level and every three rogue levels thereafter, choose a rogue special ability. Options include Crippling Strike, Defensive Roll, Improved Evasion, Opportunist, Skill Mastery, Slippery Mind, or a bonus feat. Repeated selections must follow the option's own rules; for example, Skill Mastery may be selected more than once for different skills.

classes/samurai-22.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/samurai-22.description: Proficient with simple and martial weapons and all armor, but not shields.

classes/samurai-22.name: Daisho Proficiency
classes/samurai-22.description: Gain Exotic Weapon Proficiency (bastard sword) as a bonus feat. A katana is a masterwork bastard sword; a wakizashi is a masterwork shortsword.

classes/samurai-22.name: Two Swords as One
classes/samurai-22.description: Treat yourself as having Two-Weapon Fighting only while wielding a katana and wakizashi together, without needing the feat's prerequisites. This does not grant unrestricted use with other weapons.

classes/samurai-22.name: Kiai Smite
classes/samurai-22.description: Shout to add your Charisma bonus, minimum +1, to the attack and damage rolls of your next attack. Daily uses rise from one at level 3 to two at 7, three at 12, and four at 17. Use no more than one Kiai Smite per round.

classes/samurai-22.name: Iaijutsu Master
classes/samurai-22.description: Treat yourself as having Quick Draw only when drawing your katana or wakizashi.

classes/samurai-22.name: Staredown
classes/samurai-22.description: Gain +4 on Intimidate checks and use Intimidate to demoralize an opponent. Later Staredown features expand the affected area and reduce the action cost.

classes/samurai-22.name: Improved Initiative
classes/samurai-22.description: Gain the Improved Initiative feat at level 8.

classes/samurai-22.name: Mass Staredown
classes/samurai-22.description: Use one Intimidate check to demoralize every opponent within 30 feet. This requires a standard action until Improved Staredown reduces it to a move action at level 14.

classes/samurai-22.name: Improved Two Swords as One
classes/samurai-22.description: Treat yourself as having Improved Two-Weapon Fighting while wielding a katana and wakizashi together, without needing its prerequisites. The benefit is restricted to that weapon pair.

classes/samurai-22.name: Improved Staredown
classes/samurai-22.description: Demoralize opponents within 30 feet as a move action.

classes/samurai-22.name: Greater Two Swords as One
classes/samurai-22.description: Treat yourself as having Greater Two-Weapon Fighting while wielding a katana and wakizashi together, without needing its prerequisites. The benefit is restricted to that weapon pair.

classes/samurai-22.name: Frightful Presence
classes/samurai-22.description: Drawing your blade forces opponents within 30 feet to save at Will DC 20 + your Charisma modifier. Failure causes panic for creatures with 4 or fewer HD, or shaken for 5–19 HD, lasting 4d6 rounds. Creatures with 20+ HD are unaffected; a successful save grants immunity to your presence for 24 hours.

classes/scout-2.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/scout-2.description: Proficient with all simple weapons plus handaxe, throwing axe, short sword, and shortbow, and with light armor but not shields.

classes/scout-2.name: Skirmish
classes/scout-2.description: After moving at least 10 feet in the round, gain extra precision damage and later an AC bonus. Damage starts at +1d6 and increases by +1d6 every four levels above 1st; the AC bonus begins at +1 at 3rd and increases by +1 every four levels thereafter. The AC benefit is lost in medium/heavy armor or with a medium/heavy load.

classes/scout-2.name: Trapfinding
classes/scout-2.description: Use Search to locate traps with DC above 20 and Disable Device to bypass or disarm magic traps, following the core Trapfinding rules.

classes/scout-2.name: Battle Fortitude
classes/scout-2.description: Gain a competence bonus on Fortitude saves and initiative checks: +1 at 2nd level, +2 at 11th, and +3 at 20th. The benefit is lost in medium/heavy armor or with a medium/heavy load.

classes/scout-2.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/scout-2.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized; if another class already grants Uncanny Dodge, use the normal Improved Uncanny Dodge interaction.

classes/scout-2.name: Fast Movement
classes/scout-2.description: While in light or no armor and carrying no more than a light load, increase land speed by 10 feet at 3rd level and by 20 feet at 11th level.

classes/scout-2.name: Trackless Step
classes/scout-2.description: Leave no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked there unless you choose to leave a trail.

classes/scout-2.name: Bonus Feats
classes/scout-2.description: At 4th level and every four scout levels thereafter, choose one feat from the scout bonus-feat list. You must still meet the selected feat's prerequisites.

classes/scout-2.name: Evasion
classes/scout-2.description: On a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage, take no damage instead, subject to the scout's armor/load restrictions.

classes/scout-2.name: Flawless Stride
classes/scout-2.description: Move through terrain that would normally slow movement without that reduction, subject to the source's terrain and armor/load limitations.

classes/scout-2.name: Camouflage
classes/scout-2.description: Use Hide in natural terrain even when that terrain does not provide cover or concealment, while meeting the scout's armor/load restrictions.

classes/scout-2.name: Hide in Plain Sight
classes/scout-2.description: Use Hide in natural terrain even while being observed, subject to the scout's armor/load restrictions.

classes/scout-2.name: Free Movement
classes/scout-2.description: While meeting the scout's armor/load restrictions, gain the continuous benefit of freedom of movement.

classes/shugenja-8.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/shugenja-8.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and the short sword, but not armor or shields. Armor does not interfere with shugenja spellcasting, though normal armor check penalties still apply where appropriate.

classes/shugenja-8.name: Spells
classes/shugenja-8.description: Cast divine shugenja spells spontaneously using Charisma. Spell access, save DCs, and bonus spells depend on Charisma. Your spells known include order-determined spells plus additional spells, and at least half of the spells known at each spell level must belong to your favored element. Beginning at 4th level and every even shugenja level thereafter, you may replace one eligible known spell while still honoring elemental focus. Metamagic normally increases casting time, and shugenjas cannot use Quicken Spell.

classes/shugenja-8.name: Shugenja Order

Order of the All-Seeing Eye.description: This order specializes in air magic, so Air is the normal favored element.

Order of the Consuming Flame.description: This order specializes in fire magic, so Fire is the normal favored element.

Order of the Forbidding Wasteland.description: This order specializes in water magic, so Water is the normal favored element.

Order of the Gentle Rain.description: This order specializes in water magic, so Water is the normal favored element.

Order of the Impenetrable Crucible.description: This order specializes in earth magic, so Earth is the normal favored element.

Order of the Ineffable Mystery.description: This order can specialize in any of the four ordinary elements. The source also describes a special Void tradition, which requires separate source review rather than being inferred as an ordinary element.

Order of the Perfect Sculpture.description: This order specializes in earth magic, so Earth is the normal favored element.

Order of the Spring Zephyr.description: This order specializes in air magic, so Air is the normal favored element.

classes/shugenja-8.description: Choose a Shugenja Order at 1st level. The order fixes the order spell learned at every spell level and usually determines the favored element; the Order of the Ineffable Mystery can use any of the four ordinary elements and also has the source's special Void tradition.

classes/shugenja-8.name: Element Focus
classes/shugenja-8.description: Choose air, earth, fire, or water as your favored element, subject to your Shugenja Order. At least half the non-order spells you know at each spell level must belong to that element, and you gain the source's Spell Focus benefit for spells of the favored element regardless of school. Air prohibits earth, earth prohibits air, fire prohibits water, and water prohibits fire. The Order of the Ineffable Mystery can use any of the four ordinary elements; Void remains the source's special exception rather than a normal elemental-list choice.

classes/shugenja-8.name: Sense Elements

resource.recoveryText: Sense Elements uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/shugenja-8.description: As a full-round action, sense sources of air, earth, fire, or water within 10 feet. Continued concentration can extend the radius by 5 feet per additional round up to 5 extra feet per shugenja level, or let you make Spellcraft checks for progressively more precise information. Uses are 3/day at 1st level and increase by one at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/sorcerer-98.description: Proficient with all simple weapons. Sorcerers are not proficient with armor or shields, and armor can cause arcane spell failure for spells with somatic components.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Spells
classes/sorcerer-98.description: Cast arcane spells from the sorcerer/wizard list without preparing them in advance. Charisma determines the highest spell level you can learn or cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Spells known follow the sorcerer table, and beginning at 4th level certain level gains allow one known spell to be exchanged for another spell of the same level under the class's replacement limits.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Familiar
classes/sorcerer-98.description: You can obtain one familiar through the class's familiar ritual and material cost. The familiar improves as your qualifying class levels increase; qualifying familiar-granting classes stack for familiar abilities. If the familiar dies or is dismissed, the source rules apply an XP loss and a delay before replacement.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Familiar Basics
classes/sorcerer-98.description: A familiar uses its base creature statistics with class-rule adjustments. Its effective Hit Dice, hit points, attacks, saving throws, and skills are derived partly from the master's character statistics as described by the familiar rules.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Familiar Ability Descriptions
classes/sorcerer-98.description: Familiar abilities accumulate with the master's combined levels in familiar-granting classes. They include scaling natural armor and Intelligence plus abilities such as Alertness, improved evasion, share spells, empathic link, and later familiar powers according to the familiar progression.
aliases: Speak with Animals of Its Kind

classes/soulknife-139.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/soulknife-139.description: Proficient with simple weapons, your own mind blade, light armor, and shields other than tower shields.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Mind Blade
classes/soulknife-139.description: Form a psychic shortsword sized for you; it counts as magical against damage reduction. It dissipates when released, except during a throw. Its attack and damage enhancement rises by +1 at levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20. Free Draw permits one formation attempt per round from level 5. In a psionics-negating area, a DC 20 Will save sustains it for class-level rounds; retrying formation there costs a move action.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Weapon Focus (Mind Blade)
classes/soulknife-139.description: Gain Weapon Focus (mind blade) as a bonus feat, applying its attack bonus to your mind blade.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Wild Talent
classes/soulknife-139.description: Gain Wild Talent as a bonus feat, providing psionic power even if you have no other power-point reserve.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Throw Mind Blade
classes/soulknife-139.description: Throw your mind blade with a 30-foot range increment. It dissipates after the attack, hit or miss. Psychic Strike and other applicable mind-blade abilities can accompany the throw.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Psychic Strike
classes/soulknife-139.description: Charge the blade to deal extra damage on its next successful hit against a living, nonmindless creature without immunity to mind-affecting effects. Damage is 1d8 at level 3 and increases by 1d8 at levels 7, 11, 15, and 19. This is not precision damage. The charge survives dismissal or a missed throw until used; charging again costs a move action.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Free Draw
classes/soulknife-139.description: Materialize your mind blade as a free action, with only one formation attempt per round. This limit also matters when a psionics-negating effect requires a Will save.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Shape Mind Blade
classes/soulknife-139.description: Reshape the blade into a longsword or bastard sword, or split it into two shortswords. A bastard sword requires two hands without its exotic weapon proficiency. Each split blade has an enhancement bonus 1 lower than a single blade, and normal two-weapon penalties apply.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Mind Blade Enhancement
classes/soulknife-139.description: Select weapon abilities from the source's mind-blade table within a total equivalent bonus of +1 at level 6, +2 at 10, +3 at 14, or +4 at 18. This budget is separate from the blade's attack and damage enhancement. The configuration persists across blade forms and re-creation; reassignment requires 8 hours of concentration. Record the combination and verify its costs against the source table.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Speed of Thought
classes/soulknife-139.description: Gain Speed of Thought as a bonus feat at level 6; its normal conditions still govern the movement benefit.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Bladewind
classes/soulknife-139.description: Replace a full attack with one melee attack at your full base attack bonus against each opponent within reach. Each blade fragment retains the current blade's form and properties. Forfeit bonus or extra attacks from other abilities; the blade then returns to its previous form.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Mind Blade)
classes/soulknife-139.description: Gain Greater Weapon Focus (mind blade) as a bonus feat at level 9.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Knife to the Soul
classes/soulknife-139.description: When charging Psychic Strike, allocate any of its extra damage dice to Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma damage instead: each sacrificed die deals 1 point to the chosen score. Decide the score and allocation when charging; any remaining dice still deal Psychic Strike damage.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Multiple Throw
classes/soulknife-139.description: You may throw as many mind blades in a round as the number of melee attacks you could make, including applicable two-weapon attacks.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Proficient with the club, dagger, dart, handaxe, javelin, longspear, quarterstaff, shortspear, spear, sling, shortbow, throwing axe, light armor, and shields.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Spells
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Cast divine spells from the druid list using a daily spell-retrieval system. Wisdom determines the highest spell level you can retrieve or cast and bonus spells per day; Charisma sets spell save DCs. Each day you retrieve a limited selection of druid spells, then cast those retrieved spells spontaneously within your spells-per-day limits. Metamagic is applied when a spell is retrieved rather than on the fly.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Spirit Guide
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Choose the personal form of your spirit guide at 1st level. The guide is not a separate creature and grants no benefit based on its chosen form, but it grants Alertness and later enables Follow the Guide and Guide Magic.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Improve an animal's attitude with a wild-empathy check of 1d20 + spirit-shaman level + Charisma modifier. The animal normally must be within 30 feet and able to study you. Unlike druid/ranger wild empathy, this version does not affect magical beasts.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Chastise Spirits (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: As a standard action, deal 1d6 damage per spirit-shaman level to all spirits within 30 feet. A Will save with DC 10 + spirit-shaman level + Charisma modifier halves the damage, and incorporeal spirits do not receive the normal miss chance against this effect. Uses per day equal 3 + your Charisma modifier.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Detect Spirits (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: At will, use detect spirits as a spell-like ability. It functions like detect undead but detects creatures defined as spirits by the spirit-shaman class.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Blessing of the Spirits (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Perform a 10-minute personal rite that protects you as protection from evil would, except the protection applies to spirits. The blessing lasts until dismissed or dispelled and can be recreated with another 10-minute rite.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Follow the Guide (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: If you fail a saving throw against an enchantment spell or effect, attempt the same save once more 1 round later at the same DC.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Ghost Warrior (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Weapons you hold gain the ghost touch property while held. Against incorporeal touch attacks, use your normal Armor Class instead of touch AC.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Warding of the Spirits (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Once per day, perform a 1-minute rite to ward yourself and nearby companions against hostile spirits. The ward lasts 10 minutes per spirit-shaman level and functions like magic circle against evil except that it applies to spirits.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Spirit Form (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Once per day at 9th level, as a standard action, become incorporeal for up to 1 minute with the source-listed incorporeal defenses, movement, deflection AC, and touch attack. Uses improve to twice per day at 15th level and three times per day at 20th.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Guide Magic (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: As a free action, assign your spirit guide to maintain concentration on one concentration-duration spell or spell-like ability. You can act normally while the guide concentrates, using your normal Concentration modifier when a check is required.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Recall Spirit (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Once per week, reconnect a recently deceased creature's spirit to its body if used within 1 round of death. The effect functions like the source's modified raise dead ability without normal level loss.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Exorcism (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: As a full-round action, attempt to force a possessing spirit or creature from its host with a class-level check plus Charisma modifier against DC 10 + the possessor's Hit Dice + its Charisma modifier. A successfully exorcised spirit cannot possess the same victim for 24 hours.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Weaken Spirits (Su)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: When using Chastise Spirits, trade 3d6 chastise damage for 1 round of weakening. Affected spirits lose the source-listed spell resistance, damage reduction, and incorporeal defenses for the duration; spirits that succeed on the chastise save are not weakened.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Spirit Journey (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Once per day, travel bodily through the spirit world as a self-only version of shadow walk without requiring a shadowy starting area.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Favored of the Spirits (Sp)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Perform an 8-hour rite and pay the source-listed XP cost to gain a persistent death warding effect. If you fall to 0 or fewer hit points or an ability score reaches 0, the ward immediately produces a heal effect and is then discharged.

classes/spirit-shaman-9.name: Spirit Who Walks (Ex)
classes/spirit-shaman-9.description: Your type is treated as fey instead of humanoid for spells and magical effects, and you gain damage reduction 5/cold iron.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons and light armor. Several class features stop functioning in medium/heavy armor or while carrying a medium/heavy load.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Weapon Finesse
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat at 1st level even if you do not meet its normal prerequisites.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Grace
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Gain +1 competence on Reflex saves at 2nd level, +2 at 11th, and +3 at 20th. This benefit is lost in medium/heavy armor or with a medium/heavy load.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Insightful Strike
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Add your Intelligence bonus to damage with light weapons and other Weapon-Finesse-eligible weapons, in addition to Strength where applicable. Targets immune to sneak attacks or critical hits are immune; the benefit is lost in medium/heavy armor or with a medium/heavy load.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Dodge Bonus
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: During your action, designate one melee opponent and gain +1 dodge AC against that opponent. The bonus improves to +2 at 10th, +3 at 15th, and +4 at 20th. You may designate a new opponent on any action; the benefit is lost in medium/heavy armor or with a medium/heavy load.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Acrobatic Charge
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Charge through terrain or ally-occupied paths that would normally prevent charging, while still making any appropriate movement checks the situation requires.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Improved Flanking
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: When you flank an opponent, your own attack bonus from flanking is +4 instead of +2; allies flanking with you do not gain the increased bonus.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Lucky

resource.recoveryText: The once-per-day reroll refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Once per day, reroll one failed attack roll, skill check, ability check, or saving throw. You must use the second result even if it is worse.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Acrobatic Skill Mastery
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: Take 10 on Jump or Tumble checks even when stress or distractions would normally prevent taking 10.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Weakening Critical
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: When you score a critical hit against a creature vulnerable to critical hits, also deal 2 points of Strength damage.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Slippery Mind
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: If you fail a save against an enchantment spell or effect, attempt the same save once more 1 round later at the same DC.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Wounding Critical
classes/swashbuckler-23.description: When you score a critical hit against a creature vulnerable to critical hits, also deal 2 Constitution damage in addition to the Strength damage from Weakening Critical.

classes/warlock-4.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/warlock-4.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields. Warlock invocations, including Eldritch Blast, can be used in light armor without arcane spell failure; medium/heavy armor or shields can impose arcane spell failure on invocations.

classes/warlock-4.name: Invocations
classes/warlock-4.description: Use known invocations at will as spell-like abilities. Using an invocation is normally a standard action that can provoke attacks of opportunity and can be disrupted; Charisma sets invocation save DCs. Invocation grades progress from least to lesser, greater, and dark, with replacement allowed at levels when a new invocation is learned under the source rules.

classes/warlock-4.name: Eldritch Blast
classes/warlock-4.description: Make a 60-foot ranged touch attack that deals 1d6 damage at 1st level and scales with warlock level to 9d6 at 20th. Eldritch Blast is a spell-like ability subject to spell resistance, deals half damage to objects, and can be modified by eligible blast-shape and eldritch-essence invocations.

classes/warlock-4.name: Detect Magic
classes/warlock-4.description: Use detect magic at will as a spell-like ability with caster level equal to your warlock level.

classes/warlock-4.name: Damage Reduction
classes/warlock-4.description: Gain damage reduction 1/cold iron at 3rd level. It improves to 2 at 7th, 3 at 11th, 4 at 15th, and 5 at 19th level.

classes/warlock-4.name: Deceive Item
classes/warlock-4.description: When making a Use Magic Device check, you can take 10 even while distracted or threatened.

classes/warlock-4.name: Fiendish Resilience

resource.recoveryText: The once-per-day use refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/warlock-4.description: Once per day, as a free action, enter a 2-minute state that grants fast healing 1. The fast healing improves to 2 at 13th level and 5 at 18th level.

classes/warlock-4.name: Energy Resistance
classes/warlock-4.description: At 10th level choose two different energy types from acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic. Gain resistance 5 against both chosen types; the same two resistances improve to 10 at 20th level and cannot be changed.

classes/warlock-4.name: Imbue Item
classes/warlock-4.description: When crafting a magic item with the appropriate item creation feat, substitute a Use Magic Device check for a required spell you do not know or cannot cast. The source sets DC 15 + spell level for arcane spells and 25 + spell level for divine spells; a failed check blocks that spell requirement until you gain a level.

classes/warmage-5.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/warmage-5.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, and light shields. At 8th level, also gain medium-armor proficiency.

classes/warmage-5.name: Spells
classes/warmage-5.description: Cast arcane spells spontaneously from the warmage list using Charisma. Charisma determines the highest spell level you can cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day; warmage spells do not require preparation.

classes/warmage-5.name: Armored Mage
classes/warmage-5.description: Ignore arcane spell failure for warmage spells in light armor and with light shields. At 8th level, medium armor also qualifies. The benefit does not apply to arcane spells from other classes.

classes/warmage-5.name: Warmage Edge
classes/warmage-5.description: When a warmage spell deals hit point damage, add your Intelligence bonus to that spell's damage. A single casting gains the bonus only once per damage instance as described by the source, even when the spell creates multiple missiles or targets.

classes/warmage-5.name: Advanced Learning
classes/warmage-5.description: At 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 16th level, add one wizard evocation spell to your warmage spell list. The chosen spell cannot exceed the highest spell level you already know, and once selected it permanently joins your warmage list.

classes/warmage-5.name: Sudden Empower
classes/warmage-5.description: Gain Sudden Empower as a bonus feat at 7th level. If you already have the feat, the source allows choosing a different feat instead.

classes/warmage-5.name: Sudden Enlarge
classes/warmage-5.description: Gain Sudden Enlarge as a bonus feat at 10th level. If you already have the feat, the source allows choosing a different feat instead.

classes/warmage-5.name: Sudden Widen
classes/warmage-5.description: Gain Sudden Widen as a bonus feat at 15th level. If you already have the feat, the source allows choosing a different feat instead.

classes/warmage-5.name: Sudden Maximize
classes/warmage-5.description: Gain Sudden Maximize as a bonus feat at 20th level. If you already have the feat, the source allows choosing a different feat instead.

classes/warrior-34.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/warrior-34.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields.

classes/warrior2-135.name: Base Save Bonuses
classes/warrior2-135.description: Use one good save progression and two poor save progressions, as defined by the generic Warrior class.

classes/warrior2-135.name: Class Skills
classes/warrior2-135.description: Choose any six skills as class skills; Craft is also a class skill.

classes/warrior2-135.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/warrior2-135.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/warrior2-135.name: Bonus Feats
classes/warrior2-135.description: Gain one bonus feat at 1st and 2nd level, then another at every even class level through 20th.

classes/wilder-140.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/wilder-140.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/wilder-140.name: Power Points/Day
classes/wilder-140.description: Use a daily power-point reserve to manifest wilder powers. Base power points follow the wilder table, with bonus power points from a high Charisma score and other valid sources.

classes/wilder-140.name: Powers Known
classes/wilder-140.description: Begin knowing one wilder power and gain additional powers known at the class-table levels. Powers normally come from the wilder list, require no preparation, and can be manifested repeatedly while sufficient power points remain. Charisma sets power save DCs and bonus power points.

classes/wilder-140.name: Maximum Power Level Known
classes/wilder-140.description: Begin with access to 1st-level powers and unlock higher power levels according to the wilder table, reaching 9th-level powers at 18th level. Learning or manifesting a power requires Charisma of at least 10 + the power's level.

classes/wilder-140.name: Wild Surge
classes/wilder-140.description: When manifesting a power, you may invoke a wild surge to increase manifester level without paying the extra augmentation power points supplied by the surge. The maximum surge is +1 at 1st level, +2 at 3rd, +3 at 7th, +4 at 11th, +5 at 15th, and +6 at 19th. Wild Surge cannot be combined with Overchannel and can trigger Psychic Enervation.

classes/wilder-140.name: Psychic Enervation
classes/wilder-140.description: After each Wild Surge, there is a 5% chance per manifester level added by the surge that Psychic Enervation occurs. On enervation, you are dazed until the end of your next turn and lose power points equal to your wilder level.

classes/wilder-140.name: Elude Touch
classes/wilder-140.description: Add your Charisma bonus to Armor Class against touch attacks, including rays. Your touch AC cannot exceed your normal Armor Class.

classes/wilder-140.name: Surging Euphoria
classes/wilder-140.description: After a successful Wild Surge, gain a morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws for rounds equal to the surge intensity. The bonus is +1 at 4th level, +2 at 12th, and +3 at 20th. Psychic Enervation prevents the bonus for that surge.

classes/wilder-140.name: Volatile Mind
classes/wilder-140.description: Telepathy powers manifested on you cost their manifester 1 additional power point at 5th level; the added cost rises to 2 at 9th, 3 at 13th, and 4 at 17th. As a standard action, you can lower this protection for 1 round.

classes/wizard-99.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/wizard-99.description: Proficient with the club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, and quarterstaff. Wizards are not proficient with armor or shields, and armor can cause arcane spell failure for spells with somatic components.

classes/wizard-99.name: Spells
classes/wizard-99.description: Prepare and cast arcane spells from the wizard list. Intelligence determines the highest spell level you can learn, prepare, or cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Wizards can learn any number of spells but must prepare their daily spells after rest and spellbook study.

classes/wizard-99.name: Bonus Languages
classes/wizard-99.description: You may choose Draconic in place of one of the bonus languages otherwise available from your race.

classes/wizard-99.name: Familiar
classes/wizard-99.description: You can obtain a familiar using the same familiar rules as a sorcerer. Levels in classes that grant familiars stack when determining familiar abilities.

classes/wizard-99.name: Scribe Scroll
classes/wizard-99.description: Gain Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat at 1st level. Wizard bonus feats gained later must come from the wizard's allowed bonus-feat categories and still require their normal prerequisites.

classes/wizard-99.name: Spellbooks
classes/wizard-99.description: Prepare wizard spells from a spellbook, except read magic. Begin with all allowed 0-level wizard spells plus selected 1st-level spells, add two spells you can cast at each new wizard level, and copy additional wizard spells under the spellbook rules. A specialist wizard gains one extra specialty-school preparation per spell level but must give up prohibited schools under the specialization rules.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/wu-jen-6.description: Proficient with all simple weapons, but not armor or shields. Armor can cause arcane spell failure for wu jen spells with somatic components.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Spells
classes/wu-jen-6.description: Prepare arcane spells from the wu jen list using Intelligence, much like a wizard. Intelligence determines spell access, bonus spells, and save DCs.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Bonus Languages
classes/wu-jen-6.description: Draconic or Giant can replace one racial bonus language available to the character.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Watchful Spirit

resource.recoveryText: Watchful Spirit refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/wu-jen-6.description: Once per day, immediately after rolling initiative but before learning your place in the initiative order, reroll the initiative check and keep the better result.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Bonus Feat
classes/wu-jen-6.description: At 1st level, gain one bonus metamagic feat. The selected feat must actually be a metamagic feat and normal prerequisites still apply.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Spell Secret
classes/wu-jen-6.description: At 3rd level and at 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level, choose one spell you know and permanently apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Still Spell, or Silent Spell without increasing its spell level. The same spell may be chosen again only for a different modification; the spell and modification cannot later be changed, and you do not need to know the applied metamagic feat.

Enlarge Spell.description: The chosen spell is permanently enlarged as Enlarge Spell without increasing its spell level.

Extend Spell.description: The chosen spell is permanently extended as Extend Spell without increasing its spell level.

Still Spell.description: The chosen spell is permanently stilled as Still Spell without increasing its spell level.

Silent Spell.description: The chosen spell is permanently silenced as Silent Spell without increasing its spell level.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Elemental Mastery
classes/wu-jen-6.description: At 6th level, choose earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. Spells of the mastered element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain +2 on saving throws against spells of that element. Spells marked All benefit from any elemental mastery.

Earth.description: Mastery of Earth: Wu Jen spells of this element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against spells of this element. Wu Jen spells marked All also benefit.

Fire.description: Mastery of Fire: Wu Jen spells of this element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against spells of this element. Wu Jen spells marked All also benefit.

Metal.description: Mastery of Metal: Wu Jen spells of this element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against spells of this element. Wu Jen spells marked All also benefit.

Water.description: Mastery of Water: Wu Jen spells of this element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against spells of this element. Wu Jen spells marked All also benefit.

Wood.description: Mastery of Wood: Wu Jen spells of this element use an effective caster level 2 higher for level-dependent variables and caster-level checks, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against spells of this element. Wu Jen spells marked All also benefit.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Spellbooks
classes/wu-jen-6.description: Prepare spells from a spellbook. The starting spellbook contains every 0-level wu jen spell plus three 1st-level spells and one additional 1st-level spell per point of Intelligence bonus. Each new wu jen level adds two spells of levels you can cast, and additional wu jen spells can be copied from other spellbooks under the normal rules.

classes/wu-jen-6.description: Choose one taboo at 1st level and one additional taboo each time you gain a Spell Secret. Violating any taboo prevents further spellcasting for the rest of that day. The source examples include dietary, ownership, offering, grooming, contact, alcohol, color, fire, and facing-direction restrictions.
