classes/thug-132.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/thug-132.description: Proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with light armor. The Thug class does not grant medium armor, heavy armor, or shield proficiency.

classes/thug-132.name: Bonus Feats
classes/thug-132.description: You do not gain the Fighter's normal bonus feat at 1st level. Beginning at 2nd level, retain the Fighter bonus-feat progression, gaining a bonus feat at 2nd level and every two class levels thereafter through 20th. Each choice may be any feat classified for Fighter bonus-feat selection for which you meet the normal prerequisites; Urban Tracking is also explicitly available to a Thug as a Fighter bonus-feat choice.

classes/wilderness-rogue-136.name: Special Abilities

Woodland Stride.description: Move through natural undergrowth such as thorns, briars, and overgrown areas at normal speed without taking damage or suffering other impairment. Enchanted or magically manipulated undergrowth can still impede you.

Camouflage.description: Use Hide in any sort of natural terrain even when that terrain does not provide cover or concealment.

Hide in Plain Sight.description: While in any sort of natural terrain, use Hide even while being observed.

classes/wilderness-rogue-136.description: At 10th level and every three Wilderness Rogue levels thereafter (13th, 16th, and 19th), choose one Rogue special ability. In addition to the standard Rogue options—Crippling Strike, Defensive Roll, Improved Evasion, Opportunist, Skill Mastery, Slippery Mind, or a bonus feat—you may choose Woodland Stride, Camouflage, or Hide in Plain Sight. Hide in Plain Sight can be chosen only after you already have Camouflage.

classes/fighter-variant-953.name: Sneak Attack
classes/fighter-variant-953.description: Deal +1d6 extra damage when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or when you flank it; the bonus increases by +1d6 every two Fighter Variant levels thereafter, reaching +10d6 at 19th level. Ranged sneak attacks require the target to be within 30 feet. Sneak-attack dice are not multiplied on a critical hit, and the attack requires a target with a vulnerable anatomy that you can see and reach without concealment.

classes/rogue-variant-958.name: Bonus Feats
classes/rogue-variant-958.description: Gain a Fighter bonus feat at 1st level, another at 2nd level, and one every two Rogue Variant levels thereafter through 20th. Each choice must come from the Fighter bonus-feat list and you must meet its normal prerequisites. These replace the Rogue's sneak-attack progression.

classes/wizard-variant-959.name: Bonus Feats
classes/wizard-variant-959.description: Choose a feat from the Fighter bonus-feat list at 1st level and again at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th Wizard Variant level. You must meet each feat's normal prerequisites. This Fighter-list progression replaces Scribe Scroll and the standard Wizard bonus-feat list.

classes/ranger-variant-956.name: Fast Movement
classes/ranger-variant-956.description: Your land speed increases by 10 feet while you wear no armor, light armor, or medium armor and are not carrying a heavy load. Apply this bonus before reductions from armor or encumbrance.

classes/ranger-variant-956.name: Wild Shape
classes/ranger-variant-956.description: At 5th level, you can change into a familiar Small or Medium animal and back once per day. Changing form is a standard action, does not provoke an attack of opportunity, and the animal form lasts up to 1 hour per Ranger Variant level or until you revert. Your allowed forms remain Small or Medium animals only; you do not gain the Druid's later Large, Tiny, Huge, plant, or elemental form expansions. Daily uses increase to 2 at 6th level, 3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 14th, and 6 at 18th.

classes/monk-variant-954.name: AC Bonus (Ex)
classes/monk-variant-954.description: While unarmored, unencumbered, and not using a shield, add your Wisdom bonus (if any) to Armor Class, including touch AC and while flat-footed. You lose this Wisdom-to-AC benefit while immobilized or helpless, while wearing armor, while using a shield, or while carrying a medium or heavy load. Unlike a standard Monk, this variant does not gain the additional +1 class AC bonus at 5th level or its later increases.

classes/monk-variant-954.name: Damage Reduction
classes/monk-variant-954.description: Gain damage reduction 1/- against weapon and natural-attack damage at 7th level. It improves to 2/- at 10th level, 3/- at 13th, 4/- at 16th, and 5/- at 19th. Damage reduction can reduce an instance of damage to 0 but not below 0.

classes/paladin-variant-955.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
classes/paladin-variant-955.description: At 1st level, choose one favored enemy from aberrations, dragons, giants, monstrous humanoids, evil outsiders, or undead. Gain +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against that enemy and +2 on weapon damage rolls against it. At 5th level and every five Paladin Variant levels thereafter, choose one additional favored enemy from that restricted list and increase the bonus against any one favored enemy by +2; the newly selected enemy can receive that increase.

classes/barbarian-variant-950.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
classes/barbarian-variant-950.description: At 1st level, choose one favored enemy from the Ranger favored-enemy list. Gain +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against that enemy and +2 on weapon damage rolls against it. At 5th level and every five Barbarian Variant levels thereafter, choose one additional favored enemy and increase the bonus against any one favored enemy by +2; the newly selected enemy can receive that increase. Humanoid and outsider choices require the listed subtype.

classes/barbarian-variant-950.name: Combat Style (Ex)
classes/barbarian-variant-950.description: Gain the Ranger Archery combat style at 2nd level: you are treated as having Rapid Shot even without its normal prerequisites. This benefit functions only while you wear light armor or no armor.

classes/barbarian-variant-950.name: Improved Combat Style (Ex)
classes/barbarian-variant-950.description: At 6th level, your Archery combat style improves so you are treated as having Manyshot even without its normal prerequisites. This benefit functions only while you wear light armor or no armor.

classes/barbarian-variant-950.name: Combat Style Mastery (Ex)
classes/barbarian-variant-950.description: At 11th level, your Archery combat style improves again so you are treated as having Improved Precise Shot even without its normal prerequisites. This benefit functions only while you wear light armor or no armor.

classes/druid-variant-952.name: AC Bonus (Ex)
classes/druid-variant-952.description: While unarmored, unencumbered, and not using a shield, add your Wisdom bonus (if any) to Armor Class, including touch AC and while flat-footed. You lose these bonuses while immobilized or helpless, while wearing armor, while using a shield, or while carrying a medium or heavy load. In addition, gain a +1 class AC bonus at 5th level, increasing to +2 at 10th, +3 at 15th, and +4 at 20th.

classes/druid-variant-952.name: Fast Movement (Ex)
classes/druid-variant-952.description: At 3rd level, gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to speed while unarmored and not carrying a medium or heavy load. The bonus improves to +20 feet at 6th level, +30 at 9th, +40 at 12th, +50 at 15th, and +60 at 18th.

classes/druid-variant-952.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
classes/druid-variant-952.description: At 1st level, choose one favored enemy from the Ranger favored-enemy list. Gain +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against that enemy and +2 on weapon damage rolls against it. At 5th level and every five Druid Variant levels thereafter, choose one additional favored enemy and increase the bonus against any one favored enemy by +2; the newly selected enemy can receive that increase. Humanoid and outsider choices require the listed subtype.

classes/druid-variant-952.name: Swift Tracker (Ex)
classes/druid-variant-952.description: Beginning at 8th level, follow tracks at normal speed without the usual -5 penalty, and take only a -10 penalty instead of -20 when tracking at up to twice normal speed.

classes/druid-variant-952.name: Track
classes/druid-variant-952.description: Gain Track as a bonus feat at 1st level.

classes/bard.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/bard.description: Proficient with all simple weapons plus longsword, rapier, sap, short sword, shortbow, and whip; proficient with light armor and shields except tower shields. Bard spells can be cast in light armor without arcane spell failure, while medium/heavy armor and shields still risk failure for somatic bard spells.

classes/bard.name: Spells
classes/bard.description: Cast arcane spells from the Bard list without preparing them. Charisma determines the highest spell level you can cast, spell save DCs, and bonus spells per day. Bard spells have a verbal component, and spells known/spells per day follow the Bard progression.

classes/bard.name: Bardic Knowledge
classes/bard.description: Make a special knowledge check equal to 1d20 + bard level + Intelligence modifier to recall relevant information about notable people, legendary items, or noteworthy places. You cannot take 10 or 20 on this check.

classes/bard.name: Bardic Music
classes/bard.description: Use bardic music once per day per bard level. Starting a bardic music effect is a standard action unless its feature says otherwise and requires the source-listed Perform ranks. While maintaining bardic music you cannot cast spells or activate spell-completion, spell-trigger, or command-word magic items.

classes/bard.name: Countersong
classes/bard.description: Use bardic music to counter sonic or language-dependent magical attacks for up to 10 rounds. Each round make a Perform check; affected allies within 30 feet may use that result in place of their saving throw when it is higher, including new saves against ongoing effects.

classes/bard.name: Fascinate
classes/bard.description: Use bardic music to fascinate creatures within 90 feet that can see, hear, and pay attention to you. The target makes a Will save against your Perform check. You can affect one creature at 1st level plus one additional creature for every three bard levels beyond 1st, and maintain the effect by concentrating for up to 1 round per bard level.

classes/bard.name: Inspire Courage
classes/bard.description: Use bardic music to grant allies who can hear you a +1 morale bonus on saves against charm and fear and +1 morale on attack and weapon damage rolls. The bonus becomes +2 at 8th level, +3 at 14th, and +4 at 20th, and lasts while heard and for 5 rounds afterward.

classes/bard.name: Inspire Competence
classes/bard.description: At 3rd level, use bardic music to grant one ally within 30 feet who can see and hear you a +2 competence bonus on checks with one skill. You must concentrate and can maintain the effect for up to 2 minutes; you cannot target yourself.

classes/bard.name: Suggestion
classes/bard.description: At 6th level, make a suggestion as the spell to a creature you have already fascinated. The Will save DC is 10 + half your bard level + your Charisma modifier. Using suggestion this way does not consume an additional daily bardic music use.

classes/bard.name: Inspire Greatness
classes/bard.description: At 9th level, use bardic music on yourself or a willing ally within 30 feet. The target gains 2 bonus d10 Hit Dice with corresponding temporary hit points, +2 competence on attack rolls, and +1 competence on Fortitude saves. Gain one additional target every three bard levels beyond 9th.

classes/bard.name: Song of Freedom
classes/bard.description: At 12th level, perform for 1 uninterrupted minute to produce break enchantment on one target within 30 feet other than yourself, using your bard level as caster level.

classes/bard.name: Inspire Heroics
classes/bard.description: At 15th level, use bardic music on yourself or a willing ally within 30 feet. The target gains +4 morale on saving throws and +4 dodge AC while hearing you and for up to 5 rounds afterward. Gain one additional target every three bard levels beyond 15th.

classes/bard.name: Mass Suggestion
classes/bard.description: At 18th level, use the suggestion bardic music ability simultaneously on any number of creatures you have already fascinated.

classes/bard-variant-951.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
classes/bard-variant-951.description: Choose an animal companion from the Druid list. Standard companions are always available; stronger alternatives unlock at effective druid levels 4, 7, 10, 13, and 16 and reduce the level used for companion abilities by 3, 6, 9, 12, or 15 respectively. The companion gains bonus Hit Dice, natural armor, Strength/Dexterity, bonus tricks, and abilities from the Druid companion progression. Replacing a released or lost companion requires 24 uninterrupted hours of prayer.

classes/bard-variant-951.name: Nature Sense (Ex)
classes/bard-variant-951.description: Gain +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.

classes/bard-variant-951.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
classes/bard-variant-951.description: Improve an animal's attitude with a wild-empathy check of 1d20 + Bard Variant level + Charisma modifier. You can also influence an Intelligence 1 or 2 magical beast with a -4 penalty.

classes/bard-variant-951.name: Resist Nature’s Lure (Ex)
classes/bard-variant-951.description: Gain +4 on saving throws against the spell-like abilities of fey.

classes/sorcererwizard-variant-957.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
classes/sorcererwizard-variant-957.description: Gain an animal companion as a Druid, but use one-half your Sorcerer/Wizard class level (fractions round down under the general 3.5 rule) as the base effective druid level for companion progression. Standard companions remain selectable; stronger alternatives require the corresponding effective druid level and apply their normal level adjustment.

classes/cleric-variant-972.name: Spontaneous Casting
classes/cleric-variant-972.description: Retain the Cleric's spontaneous casting rule and record the positive- or negative-energy polarity that the class would normally channel. A good cleric or a neutral cleric of a good deity uses positive energy and spontaneous cure spells; an evil cleric or a neutral cleric of an evil deity uses negative energy and spontaneous inflict spells. A neutral cleric of a neutral deity chooses one polarity permanently. For this variant, positive energy grants Smite Evil and negative energy grants Smite Good.

Positive energy.name: Smite Evil
Positive energy.description: Once per day at 1st level, declare a smite on one normal melee attack against an evil creature. Add your Charisma bonus to the attack roll and your Cleric Variant level to damage. If the target is not evil, the smite has no effect but the use is still spent. Gain a second daily use at 5th level and one additional use every five Cleric Variant levels thereafter, to 5/day at 20th.

Negative energy.name: Smite Good
Negative energy.description: Once per day at 1st level, declare a smite on one normal melee attack against a good creature. Add your Charisma bonus to the attack roll and your Cleric Variant level to damage. If the target is not good, the smite has no effect but the use is still spent. Gain a second daily use at 5th level and one additional use every five Cleric Variant levels thereafter, to 5/day at 20th.

classes/cleric-variant-972.name: Aura of Courage (Su)
classes/cleric-variant-972.description: At 3rd level, become immune to fear. While you are conscious, each ally within 10 feet gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

classes/abjurer-variant-960.name: Resistance to Energy (Su)
classes/abjurer-variant-960.description: Once per day as a standard action, touch yourself or one creature to grant resistance against acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic equal to 5 + one-half your Abjurer Variant level. The protection lasts 1 hour and overlaps rather than stacks with resist energy.

classes/abjurer-variant-960.name: Aura of Protection (Ex)
classes/abjurer-variant-960.description: At 5th level, as a standard action, gain a deflection bonus to AC and a resistance bonus on all saving throws equal to your Intelligence modifier. Each use lasts up to 1 minute but ends after the first attack against you or the first saving throw you must make. Use once per day at 5th level and one additional time per day for every five Abjurer Variant levels above 5th.

classes/abjurer-variant-960.name: Spontaneous Dispelling (Ex)
classes/abjurer-variant-960.description: At 5th level, lose prepared spells totaling at least four spell levels to cast dispel magic spontaneously; 0-level spells do not count. At 11th level, you may instead lose prepared spells totaling at least seven spell levels to cast greater dispel magic. You may combine this ability with a readied action to use either spell as a counterspell.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/streetfighter-197.description: Gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies from Streetfighter.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Always Ready
classes/streetfighter-197.description: Gain a competence bonus on initiative checks: +1 at 1st level, +2 at 3rd, and +3 at 5th.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Streetwise
classes/streetfighter-197.description: Gain a +2 competence bonus on Gather Information and Knowledge (local) checks.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Stand Tough

resource.recoveryText: Stand Tough daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/streetfighter-197.description: When damaged by a weapon or other blow rather than a spell or special ability, attempt a Fortitude save against the damage dealt; on success take no lethal damage and instead take nonlethal damage equal to half the original damage. Use once per day at 2nd level and twice per day at 4th.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Sneak Attack
classes/streetfighter-197.description: Deal +1d6 sneak attack damage when flanking or when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus; ranged sneak attacks require the target to be within 30 feet. This stacks with sneak attack from other sources.

classes/streetfighter-197.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/streetfighter-197.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent. If another class already grants Uncanny Dodge, use the normal Improved Uncanny Dodge interaction instead.

classes/survivor-822.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/survivor-822.description: Gain no new weapon, armor, or shield proficiencies from Survivor.

classes/survivor-822.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/survivor-822.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. At 3rd level you can no longer normally be flanked, except by a rogue at least four levels higher than your Survivor level.

classes/survivor-822.name: Evasion
classes/survivor-822.description: While wearing light or no armor, take no damage on a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage.

classes/survivor-822.name: Improved Evasion
classes/survivor-822.description: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save against effects that normally deal half damage, and only half damage on a failed save.

classes/survivor-822.name: Damage Reduction
classes/survivor-822.description: Gain damage reduction 5/—. It stacks with other damage reduction of the x/— type.

classes/tempest-198.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/tempest-198.description: Gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies from Tempest.

classes/tempest-198.name: Tempest Defense
classes/tempest-198.description: While wielding a double weapon or two weapons other than natural weapons or unarmed strikes, gain +1 AC at 1st level, +2 at 3rd, and +3 at 5th. This benefit is lost in medium or heavy armor.

classes/tempest-198.name: Ambidexterity
classes/tempest-198.description: Reduce two-weapon fighting attack penalties by 1 at 2nd level and by another 1 at 4th level, subject to the source's main-hand/off-hand values. This benefit is lost in medium or heavy armor.

classes/tempest-198.name: Two-Weapon Versatility
classes/tempest-198.description: While fighting with two weapons, apply Greater Weapon Focus, Greater Weapon Specialization, Improved Critical, Weapon Focus, and Weapon Specialization from one weapon to the other when legally applicable.

classes/tempest-198.name: Two-Weapon Spring Attack
classes/tempest-198.description: When making a spring attack, attack once each with two different weapons as the attack action. This benefit is lost in medium or heavy armor.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Gain proficiency with all simple weapons.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Fast Acrobatics
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Ignore the normal accelerated-movement penalties described by the source when balancing at full speed, climbing at half speed as a move action, or tumbling at full speed.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Kip Up
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Stand from prone as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity while in light or no armor and carrying no more than a light load.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Steady Stance
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: You are not flat-footed while balancing or climbing, and add your class level on Balance or Climb checks made to remain balancing or climbing after taking damage.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Agile Fighting
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Gain +1 dodge AC, or +2 while fighting defensively or using total defense; at 4th level these become +2 and +3. You also avoid the normal AC and melee attack penalties for kneeling, sitting, or prone. Requires light/no armor and no more than a light load.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Slow Fall
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Reduce effective falling distance by 20 feet at 2nd level and 30 feet at 4th. If another class grants Slow Fall, the distances stack as specified by the source.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Acrobatic Charge
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Charge across difficult terrain or through allies that would normally prevent charging, while still making any movement checks the situation requires.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Defensive Roll

resource.recoveryText: Defensive Roll daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Use Defensive Roll once per day at 3rd level and twice per day at 5th level, following the rogue Defensive Roll rules to reduce a potentially lethal blow.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Skill Mastery
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Take 10 on Balance, Climb, Jump, and Tumble checks even when stress or distractions would normally prevent taking 10.

classes/thief-acrobat-199.name: Improved Evasion
classes/thief-acrobat-199.description: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save against applicable attacks and only half damage on a failed save.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: Gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies from Dark Hunter.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Improved Stonecunning
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: Gain dwarf-like stonecunning; if you already have stonecunning, improve its bonus from +2 to +4 on checks to notice unusual stonework and on Search checks to detect stonework traps.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Enhanced Darkvision
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: At 2nd level gain darkvision 30 feet if you lacked it, or add 30 feet to existing natural/extraordinary darkvision; at 4th level increase the range by another 30 feet. It stacks with natural or extraordinary darkvision improvements but not magically granted darkvision.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Sneak Attack
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack damage under the normal sneak attack conditions; ranged attacks require the target within 30 feet, and this bonus stacks with sneak attack from other sources.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Stone’s Hue
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: While within 5 feet of a stone or earth wall, gain a +10 circumstance bonus on Hide checks and may hide in the open by blending with the wall.

classes/dark-hunter-307.name: Death Attack
classes/dark-hunter-307.description: After studying a victim for 3 rounds, make a damaging melee sneak attack within the next 3 rounds to attempt either paralysis or death. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + Dark Hunter level + Intelligence modifier; a failed paralysis save leaves the victim helpless for 1d6 rounds + class level.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies from Darkwood Stalker.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Ancient Foe
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Against orcs gain +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks and on qualifying weapon damage; the bonus becomes +4 at 4th, +6 at 7th, and +8 at 10th. It stacks with favored enemy bonuses.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. If you already have Uncanny Dodge from another class, gain the normal Improved Uncanny Dodge interaction instead.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Sneak Attack
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Gain sneak attack damage against vulnerable foes under the standard sneak attack rules; progression increases it to +2d6 at 6th level and +3d6 at 9th.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Darkvision
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Gain darkvision 30 feet at 4th level and 60 feet at 7th level. If you already have racial darkvision, this class feature does not increase it.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: You can no longer normally be flanked; a rogue at least four levels higher can still flank you. Levels in other classes that grant Uncanny Dodge stack as specified by the source when determining the rogue level required.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Dodge Critical

resource.recoveryText: Dodge Critical refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: Once per day, when aware of a critical hit and not flat-footed, attempt a Reflex save against DC 20 + the weapon's enhancement bonus to turn the critical hit into a normal hit. Declare before damage is rolled.

classes/darkwood-stalker-308.name: Death Attack
classes/darkwood-stalker-308.description: After studying an orc for 3 rounds, make a damaging melee sneak attack within the next 3 rounds to attempt a killing blow. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + Darkwood Stalker level + Wisdom modifier.

classes/avenging-executioner-289.name: Bloody Blade
classes/avenging-executioner-289.description: Whenever a melee sudden strike deals damage, the target and visible opponents within 30 feet are shaken for a number of rounds equal to your Avenging Executioner level unless they succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + class level + Charisma modifier). Creatures with more HD than your character level are unaffected.

classes/avenging-executioner-289.name: Sudden Strike
classes/avenging-executioner-289.description: Deal extra precision damage when an opponent is unable to defend effectively. The progression grants +1d6 at 1st level, +2d6 at 3rd, and +3d6 at 5th.

classes/avenging-executioner-289.name: Rapid Intimidation
classes/avenging-executioner-289.description: Demoralize an opponent with Intimidate as a move action instead of a standard action. If you have Favored Enemy, add its bonus to demoralize checks against the matching enemy type.

classes/avenging-executioner-289.name: Dread Blade
classes/avenging-executioner-289.description: Treat shaken, frightened, or panicked creatures as flat-footed for the purpose of dealing sudden strike damage.

classes/avenging-executioner-289.name: Bloody Murder
classes/avenging-executioner-289.description: When a melee attack drops a creature, visible enemies within 30 feet become frightened for 1 round unless they succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + class level + Charisma modifier); a successful save reduces this to shaken. Creatures with more HD than your character level are unaffected.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/chaotician-687.description: Gain proficiency with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Chaotic Contagion

resource.recoveryText: Chaotic Contagion daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/chaotician-687.description: On a successful melee touch attack, impose -2 AC against your attacks, -2 on saves against your spells or abilities, and -2 on skill checks opposed by you for 1 hour per class level. A Will save (DC 10 + class level + Charisma modifier) negates it and grants 24-hour immunity to your further attempts. Uses per day equal class level.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Scofflaw
classes/chaotician-687.description: Lawful creatures must succeed on a caster-level check against DC 15 + class level + Charisma bonus to use divinations successfully against you. You may suppress or resume this protection as a free action.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Anarchic Grace

resource.recoveryText: Anarchic Grace daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/chaotician-687.description: As a free action, gain a 50% miss chance against attacks for a number of rounds equal to class level, then become fatigued for 1 minute. Use once per day at 2nd level and twice per day at 4th.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Babble

resource.recoveryText: Babble refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/chaotician-687.description: Once per day create a 10-foot-radius emanation in which sounds become unintelligible: verbal communication and verbal spell/item activation fail, sound-dependent effects do not function, and sonic damage has no effect.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Clarity of Confusion
classes/chaotician-687.description: Gain +2 insight on saves against illusion (pattern), enchantment (compulsion), and spells with the lawful descriptor.

classes/chaotician-687.name: Destiny’s Arbiter

resource.recoveryText: Destiny's Arbiter refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/chaotician-687.description: Once per day as a free action immediately after a roll is known, reroll your own result or force a visible creature within 60 feet to reroll; the second result stands.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: Gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies from Cragtop Archer.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Adept Climber
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Farsight
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: Take only half the normal Spot penalty for distance (-1 per 20 feet) and half the normal ranged-attack penalty per range increment (-1 rather than -2).

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Strike From Above
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: Gain +2 damage on ranged attacks made from higher ground than the target.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Arcing Shot
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: With at least 40 feet of overhead clearance, a projectile weapon's maximum range becomes fifteen range increments instead of ten.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Horizon Shot
classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: As a full-round action make one projectile-weapon attack with no range penalty, while retaining your normal maximum range and benefiting from other range-extending abilities.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.name: Mountain Skin

resource.recoveryText: Mountain Skin daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/cragtop-archer-727.description: Three times per day as a free action, gain damage reduction 5/adamantine for 5 + Constitution modifier rounds.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Gain proficiency with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Sacred Stealth

resource.recoveryText: Sacred Stealth's daily minute pool refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/divine-seeker-663.description: As a standard action gain +10 sacred (or profane for an evil patron) on Hide and Move Silently. The daily duration is a number of minutes equal to Charisma modifier, minimum 1, and may be split into increments as small as 1 round; ending it is a free action.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Thwart Magic Trap
classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Gain +3 on Disable Device and Search checks made to locate, disable, or bypass magic traps.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Sacred Defense
classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Gain +1 on saves against divine spells and outsider spell-like or supernatural abilities, increasing to +2 at 4th level.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Sneak Attack
classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack at 2nd level and +2d6 at 5th. It stacks with sneak attack from other sources, and Divine Seeker levels stack with appropriate classes for overcoming Improved Uncanny Dodge.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Locate Creature

resource.recoveryText: Locate Creature refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Use locate creature once per day at caster level equal to Divine Seeker level + Charisma modifier.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Locate Object

resource.recoveryText: Locate Object refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Use locate object once per day at caster level equal to Divine Seeker level + Charisma modifier.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Divine Perseverance

resource.recoveryText: Divine Perseverance refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Once per day, when brought to -1 hit points or lower, automatically heal 3d6 + Charisma bonus hit points.

classes/divine-seeker-663.name: Find the Path

resource.recoveryText: Find the Path refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/divine-seeker-663.description: Use find the path once per day at caster level equal to Divine Seeker level + Charisma modifier.

classes/menacing-brute-707.name: Demoralizing Stare
classes/menacing-brute-707.description: Gain a competence bonus on Intimidate equal to Menacing Brute level. A creature you successfully demoralize remains shaken for one additional round per class level.

classes/menacing-brute-707.name: Resourceful Search

resource.recoveryText: Resourceful Search refreshes with the character's daily recovery.

classes/menacing-brute-707.description: Once per day, make the source-defined Search check to find a nonmagical, non-masterwork item worth at most 200 gp without paying for it; DC, search time, and minimum community size scale with item value.

classes/menacing-brute-707.name: Sneak Attack
classes/menacing-brute-707.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack damage when flanking or when the target is denied Dexterity to AC, with the source's point-blank restriction for ranged attacks.

classes/menacing-brute-707.name: Ruthless Cut
classes/menacing-brute-707.description: Gain +4 on rolls to confirm a critical threat.

classes/menacing-brute-707.name: Making an Example
classes/menacing-brute-707.description: When a melee attack drops a creature, foes within 30 feet must make a Will save (DC 15 + Charisma modifier) or cower until the start of their next turn; if the dropping blow was a critical hit, increase the save DC by 4.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Tunnelrunner
classes/cavelord-896.description: Gain Tunnelrunner as a bonus feat at 1st level.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Cave Tracker
classes/cavelord-896.description: In a cave or tunnel, follow tracks at normal speed without taking the usual -5 penalty on the Survival check.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Lesser Cavesense
classes/cavelord-896.description: Gain darkvision out to 120 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Listen checks made in subterranean settings.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Tunnelswimmer
classes/cavelord-896.description: Hold your breath three times longer than normal before risking drowning (normally six times Constitution score in rounds for a humanoid) and gain a 30-foot swim speed.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Strength of Stones

resource.recoveryText: Strength of Stones daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/cavelord-896.description: Once per day as a free action, gain an insight bonus to Strength equal to your Cavelord level for 1 minute.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Changestones

resource.recoveryText: Changestones daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/cavelord-896.description: Use changestones once per day as a spell-like ability at caster level 14th.

classes/cavelord-896.name: Bones of the Earth
classes/cavelord-896.description: While in a cave, tunnel, or other Underdark environment, when damage would reduce you to -10 hit points or lower, attempt a Fortitude save (DC 5 + damage dealt; DC 6 for continuing bleeding). On success you turn to stone before dying, remain fixed in place for 24 hours, then return to flesh at 1 hit point with no prepared spells or power points. Significant damage to the stone form still kills you.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Defensive Refocus
classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: You can refocus while using total defense. After doing so, on following rounds you move up in the initiative count as though you had rolled a 20 on initiative.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Defensive Awareness
classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: At 2nd level retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. At 5th level you cannot normally be flanked except by a rogue at least four levels higher than your Daidoji Bodyguard level. At 10th level gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps. Levels in classes that grant uncanny dodge combine with this defensive-awareness progression as specified by the source.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Evasion
classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: While wearing light or no armor, take no damage on a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Moving the Shadow
classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: Gain a dodge bonus to AC against an opponent equal to that opponent's armor check penalty, if any.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Damage Reduction
classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: Gain damage reduction 3/— at 6th level, improving to 6/— at 9th level.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.name: Defensive Roll

resource.recoveryText: Defensive Roll daily uses refresh with the character's daily recovery.

classes/daidoji-bodyguard-630.description: Once per day, when combat damage from a weapon or other blow would reduce you to 0 hit points or lower, make a Reflex save with DC equal to the damage dealt; on success take half damage. You must be aware of and able to react to the attack, and evasion does not apply to this save.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Citadel Training
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: Gain a +2 insight bonus on Diplomacy, Gather Information, Search, and Sense Motive checks.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Sneak Attack
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack at 2nd level and another +1d6 every two class levels thereafter, reaching +5d6 at 10th level. This stacks with sneak attack from other classes.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Nondetection
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: Gain a permanent nondetection effect. A divination targeting you or anything you carry requires a caster-level check against DC 15 + your Dark Lantern level.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Skill Mastery
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: You may take 10 on Climb, Disable Device, Open Lock, and Search checks even when stress or distractions would normally prevent taking 10.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Slippery Mind
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: If you fail a save against an enchantment spell or effect, attempt one new save 1 round later at the same DC. You can also spend an action point to automatically break free of the enchantment.

classes/dark-lantern-475.name: Hide in Plain Sight
classes/dark-lantern-475.description: Use the Hide skill even while being observed.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Track
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Gain Track as a bonus feat at 1st level.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Trap Sense
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps and +1 dodge AC against attacks made by traps at 1st level. Both bonuses increase to +2 at 4th, +3 at 7th, and +4 at 10th; trap sense from multiple classes stacks.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Stone Warden
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Use your Constitution bonus in place of your Dexterity bonus to AC when Constitution is higher. You lose this substituted bonus whenever you would normally be denied Dexterity to AC and remain considered flat-footed in that situation.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Animal Messenger
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Use animal messenger as a spell-like ability with caster level equal to your Deepwarden level.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC, or the higher Constitution bonus supplied by Stone Warden, while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, use the normal improved-uncanny-dodge interaction.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Stubborn Mind
classes/deepwarden-729.description: If you fail a save against an enchantment spell or effect, attempt one new save 1 round later at the same DC. This also works against a mind flayer's mind blast, and you receive only this one extra chance.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Sending
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Use sending as a spell-like ability with caster level equal to your Deepwarden level.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Swift Tracker
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Follow tracks at normal speed without the usual -5 penalty, or at up to twice normal speed with a -10 penalty instead of -20.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
classes/deepwarden-729.description: You can no longer normally be flanked, except by a rogue with at least four more rogue levels than your relevant uncanny-dodge class levels. Levels from classes that grant uncanny dodge stack for this threshold as specified by the source.

classes/deepwarden-729.name: Greater Animal Messenger
classes/deepwarden-729.description: Your animal messenger ability can use an animal of up to Small size instead of only a Tiny animal.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Relative Altitude
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: While on the Astral Plane or another no-gravity environment, you are always considered to have higher ground over an opponent and gain +1 on melee attack rolls.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Evasion
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: At 2nd level gain evasion only in no-gravity environments. At 4th level and higher, evasion functions in all environments.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Improved Maneuverability
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: In no gravity, at 3rd level a double move reduces maneuverability only to good and movement at four times speed reduces it only to poor. At 9th level a double move retains perfect maneuverability and four-times-speed movement reduces it only to average.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Astral Dodge
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: At 5th level gain +2 dodge AC in no gravity or +1 in gravity. At 10th level these bonuses improve to +4 in no gravity or +2 in gravity.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Improved Evasion
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: At 6th level gain improved evasion only in no-gravity environments; at 8th level and higher it functions in all environments.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Astral Agility
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: Once per round as a move action in a no-gravity environment, attempt to switch places with an adjacent creature of your size or smaller. The target may resist with an opposed Intelligence check; add your Astral Dancer level to your check. The resulting movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

classes/astral-dancer-686.name: Lightning Speed
classes/astral-dancer-686.description: Your movement on the Astral Plane or a similar no-gravity environment never provokes attacks of opportunity.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Tongue of the Devil
classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Add your Intelligence modifier as well as your Charisma modifier to Bluff checks.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Sneak Attack
classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Deal +1d6 sneak attack damage at 2nd level, +2d6 at 5th, and +3d6 at 8th when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks work only within 30 feet; creatures without discernible vital areas or that are immune to critical hits are immune. Sneak attack damage from other sources stacks.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Suggestion

resource.recoveryText: Suggestion refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Once per day produce an effect identical to suggestion. The save DC is 10 + your Disciple of Baalzebul level + your Charisma bonus.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Summon Osyluth

resource.recoveryText: Summon Osyluth refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Once per day summon one osyluth, functioning as a summon monster spell cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Insect Plague

resource.recoveryText: Insect Plague refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Once per day produce an effect identical to insect plague cast by a 15th-level spellcaster; the summoned insects are always biting flies.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Beguiling Nature

resource.recoveryText: Beguiling Nature can be used once every other day.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Every other day produce an effect identical to mass charm. The Will save DC is 10 + your Disciple of Baalzebul level + your Charisma bonus.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: Summon Cornugon

resource.recoveryText: Summon Cornugon refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Once per day summon one cornugon, functioning as a summon monster spell cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.name: King of Lies
classes/disciple-of-baalzebul-166.description: Gain a +4 inherent bonus to Charisma.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Device Lore
classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Find traps made mostly of metal as a rogue can and gain a +2 competence bonus on Disable Device checks against devices made mostly of metal.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Iron Hews

resource.recoveryText: Daily uses equal your Constitution bonus.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day per point of Constitution bonus, add a +3 divine bonus on damage from attacks made that round.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Rusting Grasp

resource.recoveryText: Rusting Grasp refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day produce an effect identical to rusting grasp cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Iron Power
classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: When using an iron or steel weapon, gain a +1 insight bonus on attack and damage rolls and double the weapon's threat range. At 8th level the insight bonus becomes +2 and the threat range triples. This does not stack with the keen weapon quality but does stack with Improved Critical.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Summon Erinyes

resource.recoveryText: Summon Erinyes refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day summon one erinyes as a summon monster spell cast by a 15th-level caster. At 9th level the same daily use summons 1d4 erinyes instead.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Greater Iron Hews

resource.recoveryText: Daily uses equal your Constitution bonus and are separate from Iron Hews.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day per point of Constitution bonus, add a +6 divine bonus on damage from attacks made that round. This does not stack with Iron Hews, but each ability has its own daily uses.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Ironskin

resource.recoveryText: Ironskin refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day produce an effect identical to stoneskin cast by a 15th-level caster, affecting yourself only.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.name: Iron Body

resource.recoveryText: Iron Body refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-dispater-167.description: Once per day produce an effect identical to iron body cast by an 18th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Lie
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Gain a +4 competence bonus on Bluff checks and spell resistance 11 + class level against spells that reveal falsehood, even when spell resistance is normally not allowed.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Cheat

resource.recoveryText: Daily uses equal your Disciple of Mammon level.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Once per day per class level, produce an effect identical to cheat cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Thief
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Gain a +4 competence bonus on Pick Pocket and Open Lock checks.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Steal
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Call a single unattended object weighing no more than 5 pounds to you as if using telekinesis cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Divert Attack

resource.recoveryText: Divert Attack refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Three times per day, redirect an opponent's melee attack meant for you to another character within the attacker's reach. The new target must also be a foe of the attacker; if none is available, the maneuver fails.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Summon Osyluth

resource.recoveryText: Summon Osyluth refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Once per day summon one osyluth as a summon monster spell cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Take Object
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Gain a +4 competence bonus on attempts to disarm a foe and draw no attacks of opportunity for making an unarmed disarm attempt.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Enhance Value
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Spend 1 hour modifying a nonmagical item of value, then make an Appraise check; increase the object's value by 1% per point of the check result. You cannot enhance an item with an obvious fixed value such as a coin, and cannot enhance the same object twice.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Divert Spell

resource.recoveryText: Divert Spell refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Once per day, redirect an opponent's spell targeted on you to another target within range that is also a foe of the attacker. If no such foe is available, the maneuver fails.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Nondetection
classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Constantly produce an effect identical to nondetection cast by an 18th-level caster. The ability cannot be dispelled, but it can be suppressed.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.name: Summon Gelugon

resource.recoveryText: Summon Gelugon refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mammon-168.description: Once per day summon one gelugon as a summon monster spell cast by an 18th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Hellfire Grasp
classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: At will, deal 1d6 fire damage as a touch attack. This damage is added to damage dealt by other unarmed attacks.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Fire Adept
classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: If you can cast spells, gain +1 caster level when casting a spell with the fire descriptor.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Fire Resistance
classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Gain fire resistance 10 at 2nd level; it improves to fire resistance 20 at 6th level.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Hellfire Blast
classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: At will, release hellfire as a ranged touch attack with a 30-foot range that deals 4d6 fire damage.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Flare

resource.recoveryText: Daily uses equal your Disciple of Mephistopheles level.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Once per day per class level, produce an effect identical to flare cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Summon Hamatula

resource.recoveryText: Summon Hamatula refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Once per day summon one hamatula as a summon monster spell cast by a 15th-level caster. At 9th level the same daily use summons 1d4 hamatulas instead.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Hellfire

resource.recoveryText: Hellfire refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Three times per day produce an effect identical to hellfire cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Fire Shield

resource.recoveryText: Fire Shield refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Twice per day produce an effect identical to fire shield cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Hellfire Storm

resource.recoveryText: Hellfire Storm refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Twice per day produce an effect identical to hellfire storm cast by a 15th-level caster.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.name: Body of Flame

resource.recoveryText: Body of Flame refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/disciple-of-mephistopheles-169.description: Once per day transform your body into flame for up to 10 minutes. Gain fire immunity and damage reduction 30/+1. Creatures you touch must make Reflex DC 15 or catch fire for 1d4 rounds; creatures hitting you with natural weapons or unarmed attacks take 2d6 fire damage and also risk catching fire on the same save.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Keen Arrows
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Every projectile you fire is treated as keen in addition to its other properties; this does not stack with another keen effect.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Range Increment Bonus
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Increase the range increment of each projectile weapon you use by 10 feet per Deepwood Sniper level, applying this increase after other range multipliers.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Concealment Reduction
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Reduce your miss chance against concealment by 10 percentage points at 2nd level, 20 points at 6th, and 30 points at 10th, never below 0%.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Magic Weapon

resource.recoveryText: Magic Weapon refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Once per day, use magic weapon on projectile weapons only, with caster level equal to your Deepwood Sniper level.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Projectile Improved Critical
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Increase the critical damage multiplier of projectile weapons by 1 at 2nd level and by another 1 at 7th level.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Safe Poison Use
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: You can apply and use poison without risking accidental self-poisoning.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Take Aim
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: As a full-round action, carefully aim at a stationary target for a +2 attack bonus; the bonus is lost if the target moves more than 5 feet during the aiming period. The bonus improves to +4 at 8th level.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Consistent Aim

resource.recoveryText: Consistent Aim daily uses scale with class level and refresh with daily recovery.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: After making a projectile attack roll, reroll it and keep the new result. Use this once per day at 5th level, twice at 7th, and three times at 9th and higher.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: Keen Edge
classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: The source advancement table lists keen edge at 6th level, but the class-feature rules do not define a separate keen edge ability; no additional use or effect is automated beyond the source-supported text.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.name: True Strike

resource.recoveryText: True Strike refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/deepwood-sniper-609.description: Once per day, use true strike with caster level equal to your Deepwood Sniper level; this spell-like ability applies only to projectile weapons.

classes/tempest-621.name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
classes/tempest-621.description: While wearing light or no armor and not using a double weapon, fight with two weapons as though you had Improved Two-Weapon Fighting.

classes/tempest-621.name: Off-Hand Parry
classes/tempest-621.description: Gain Off-Hand Parry as a bonus feat. The class improves the AC benefit from this feat as you advance, reaching the source's higher listed bonuses at later Tempest levels.

classes/tempest-621.name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
classes/tempest-621.description: While wearing light or no armor and not using a double weapon, fight with two weapons as though you had Greater Two-Weapon Fighting.

classes/tempest-621.name: Absolute Ambidexterity
classes/tempest-621.description: While wearing light or no armor, reduce the attack penalties for fighting with two weapons by 2.

classes/tempest-621.name: Supreme Two-Weapon Fighting
classes/tempest-621.description: While wearing light or no armor and not using a double weapon, gain a fourth off-hand attack at a -15 penalty after the normal off-hand iterative attacks.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/yakuza-651.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. At 4th level you normally cannot be flanked except by a sufficiently higher-level rogue; at 8th level gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps. Levels in other classes that grant uncanny dodge combine as the source specifies.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Defensive Roll

resource.recoveryText: Defensive Roll refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/yakuza-651.description: Once per day, when combat damage from a weapon or similar blow would reduce you to 0 hit points or lower, make a Reflex save with DC equal to the damage dealt; on success take half damage. You must be aware of and able to react to the attack.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Improved Evasion
classes/yakuza-651.description: While wearing light or no armor, take no damage on a successful Reflex save against an effect that normally deals half damage and only half damage on a failed save.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Yakuza Knowledge
classes/yakuza-651.description: Make a special local-knowledge check using your Yakuza level plus Intelligence modifier to recall information about local people and places; you cannot take 10 or 20 on this check.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Leadership
classes/yakuza-651.description: Gain Leadership as a bonus feat. If you already have Leadership, instead gain the source's permanent +2 bonus to your Leadership score.

classes/yakuza-651.name: Slippery Mind
classes/yakuza-651.description: If you fail a save against magic that controls or compels you, attempt one new save 1 round later at the same DC.

classes/tomb-warden-554.name: Turn Immunity
classes/tomb-warden-554.description: While within the tomb, graveyard, or other resting place you protect, you are immune to turning and rebuking attempts, though you can still be bolstered.

classes/tomb-warden-554.name: Tomb Sense
classes/tomb-warden-554.description: While within the protected resting place, automatically know the precise location of every intruder there, even without line of effect.

classes/tomb-warden-554.name: Power of the Dead

resource.recoveryText: Power of the Dead refreshes with daily recovery.

classes/tomb-warden-554.description: Once per day as a free action while within the place you protect, gain an insight bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) for 10 minutes. Leaving the protected site for more than seven days or relinquishing guardianship causes the source's class-feature loss until atonement.

classes/warsling-sniper-702.name: Warsling Sneak Attack
classes/warsling-sniper-702.description: Deal +1d6 ranged sneak attack damage with a warsling at 1st level, +2d6 at 3rd, and +3d6 at 5th. The target must be within 30 feet, and this damage stacks with sneak attack from other classes.

classes/warsling-sniper-702.name: Sniper’s Vision
classes/warsling-sniper-702.description: Gain +2 on sling attacks against targets benefiting from cover. When a skiprock attack misses because of concealment, reroll the concealment miss chance.

classes/warsling-sniper-702.name: Improved Critical
classes/warsling-sniper-702.description: Gain Improved Critical for the halfling warsling as a source-specified bonus feat.

classes/warsling-sniper-702.name: Improved Ricochet
classes/warsling-sniper-702.description: Once per round when a skiprock ricochets from one target to another, make the second attack without the normal -2 penalty.

classes/tainted-warrior-882.name: Taint Suppression
classes/tainted-warrior-882.description: Your taint is normally hidden internally: do not apply your taint score as a Constitution penalty, and apply only half your taint score as a Wisdom penalty. The source's appearance exceptions still apply in tainted areas or when internal corruption is exposed.

classes/tainted-warrior-882.name: Damage Reduction
classes/tainted-warrior-882.description: Gain damage reduction 1/good at 2nd level, increasing by 1 at every even-numbered Tainted Warrior level, reaching 5/good at 10th.

classes/tainted-warrior-882.name: Tainted Strike

resource.recoveryText: Tainted Strike daily uses scale with class level and refresh with daily recovery.

classes/tainted-warrior-882.description: Infuse a melee attack with taint, adding your taint score to damage and increasing the target's taint score by 1 unless it is immune to taint. Use this once per day at 3rd level and twice per day from 7th level onward.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Rapid Shot
classes/whisperknife-747.description: When throwing light weapons, you are treated as having Rapid Shot even if you do not meet its normal prerequisites.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC while flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, use the source's improved-uncanny-dodge stacking rule.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Sneak Attack
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack at 2nd level, +2d6 at 5th, and +3d6 at 8th; ranged sneak attacks work only within 30 feet.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Defensive Throw
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Attacking with a thrown weapon no longer provokes attacks of opportunity; other ranged weapons are unaffected.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Improved Catch
classes/whisperknife-747.description: After a ranged attack with a returning weapon, you can move and still have the weapon return so long as line of sight to it exists at the beginning of your next turn.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Close Defense
classes/whisperknife-747.description: While adjacent to a Medium or larger foe, gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from foes adjacent to you; ranged and reach attacks do not receive this penalty.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Fast Movement
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Increase land speed by 10 feet while wearing no, light, or medium armor and not carrying a heavy load.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Poison Use
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Apply poison to a blade without risking accidental self-poisoning.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Vengeful Strike

resource.recoveryText: Vengeful Strike daily uses scale with class level and refresh with daily recovery.

classes/whisperknife-747.description: As a standard action, make one melee or ranged attack against a victim whose name you know. Gain +2 morale on the attack; on a hit the target must save against DC 10 + your class level + your Dexterity modifier or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. Use once per day at 7th level and three times per day at 10th.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Superior Catch
classes/whisperknife-747.description: Improve your use of returning weapons so two returning weapons can each be used for two attacks in a round, or one can be used for three attacks, subject to the source's range-increment restriction.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
classes/whisperknife-747.description: You can no longer normally be flanked, subject to the standard higher-level rogue exception and the source's class-level stacking rules.

classes/whisperknife-747.name: Ranged Flank
classes/whisperknife-747.description: When within 10 feet of a foe, you can flank that foe with a ranged weapon as though using a reach weapon, but this does not itself let you threaten the foe or make ranged attacks of opportunity.

classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.name: Improved Deflection
classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.description: Add your Ephemeral Exemplar class level to your deflection bonus to AC.

classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.name: Turn Resistance
classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.description: Add your Ephemeral Exemplar class level to your turn resistance.

classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.name: Enhanced Spawn
classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.description: Spawn you create gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity while you remain in existence; they lose the bonus if you are destroyed.

classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.name: Ghostly Grasp
classes/ephemeral-exemplar-547.description: Gain Ghostly Grasp as a bonus feat even if you do not meet its prerequisite.
